TL;DR: 本文提出 misi，一种面向通用度量空间的近邻搜索倒排索引，其词汇表为数据库的随机样本（规模与 n 成正比）。每个对象由 kb 个最近样本点表示，查询通过 idf 加权共享邻投票后对 C 个候选进行精确验证。该设计将 NAPP 索引从常数个 pivot 推广到线性规模词汇表，使 posting list 保持常数期望长度，并将索引转化为一种"组合器"。概率模型给出召回保证和匹配极限。构造过程是 n 次独立搜索，高度并行、确定性强，在受限内存下可流式运行。代价是查询时间较慢，且验证预算随 n^0.30 增长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有近似最近邻索引常依赖图结构或常数个 pivot，存在构造开销大、不可并行化、内存占用高、依赖欧氏空间等不足。作者希望设计一种结构上更优的索引：构造可大规模并行、确定性强、内存占用低、适用于任意度量空间，并适合频繁重建、批量相似度和受限内存服务等应用场景。

Method: (1) 词汇表为数据库的随机样本，规模与 n 成正比（αn 个样本点）；(2) 每个对象用其 kb 个最近样本点表示；(3) 通过可插拔的内层索引在样本上搜索；(4) 查询采用 idf 加权共享邻投票，随后对 C 个候选进行精确验证；(5) posting list 期望长度为常数 ρ=kb/α；(6) 索引作为组合器：任何在 αn 点上有高召回率的索引都可转化为 n 点上的索引；(7) 概率模型给出 kb 需对数于 n 的召回保证，并指出投票无法分辨低于 1/√kb 阶的重叠差异。

Result: 构造 10^8 向量在 64 核上耗时 5,250 秒，比匹配召回率的图构建快 3.7 倍；3 GiB 内存上限下可流式构建；8 GB 内存预算内可从 NVMe 服务 10^8 向量。代价是查询吞吐：饱和图基线在 RAM 中快 6-16 倍；0.99 召回率的验证预算按 n^0.30 增长。所有结果可复现，含种子、饱和扫描和负结果。

Conclusion: misi 的强度在结构层面：构造简单可并行、确定性强、内存友好、适用于任意度量空间（黑盒指标）。其代价是查询时间。该索引特别适合频繁重建的语料库、批量相似度任务和受限内存服务等场景，在这些场景下构造成本、确定性、内存占用或黑盒度量比峰值吞吐更重要。

Abstract: We present misi, an inverted index for approximate nearest-neighbor search over general metric spaces whose vocabulary is a random sample of the database, of size proportional to $n$. Each object is represented by its $k_b$ nearest sample points, found by a pluggable inner index over the sample; queries are answered by an idf-weighted shared-neighbor vote followed by exact verification of $C$ candidates. The construction generalizes the NAPP index from a constant number of pivots to a linear-size vocabulary, which keeps posting lists at constant expected length $ρ= k_b/α$ as $n$ grows and turns the index into a combinator: any high-recall index on $αn$ points yields an index on $n$ points, for any metric. A probabilistic model gives a recall guarantee -- $k_b$ logarithmic in $n$ over the overlap gap suffices, with a verification budget the index itself estimates -- and a matching limit: the vote cannot resolve overlap differences below order $1/\sqrt{k_b}$. The design's strengths are structural: construction is $n$ independent searches -- embarrassingly parallel, deterministic, $5{,}250$ s for $10^8$ vectors on 64 cores, $3.7\times$ faster than a matched-recall graph build -- it streams under an enforced 3 GiB cap, and the portable artifact serves $10^8$ vectors from NVMe within an enforced 8 GB budget, below the working floor of the SSD-graph baseline. Its cost is query-time work: saturated graph baselines answer $6$-$16\times$ faster in RAM, and the verification budget for 0.99 recall grows as $n^{0.30}$. All results carry seeds, saturation sweeps and full configurations, are generated from run manifests, and include measured negative results. The intended applications weight construction cost, determinism, memory footprint, or black-box metrics over peak throughput: frequently rebuilt corpora, batch similarity workloads, constrained-memory serving.

</details>


<div id='cs.GT'></div>

# cs.GT [[Back]](#toc)

### [304] [Simultaneous Envy and Equitability Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26410)
*Hadi Hosseini,Shraddha Pathak,Lirong Xia,Chengkai Zhang*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究了公平分配中两种根本不同的公平概念——无嫉妒（envy-freeness）和公平性（equitability）的兼容性，重点关注不可分割商品和杂物（chores）两种场景。研究发现即使对于归一化的可加性估值，EF1+EQ1分配也可能不存在；但算法可在至多七个代理人的归一化二元商品场景下计算EF1+EQ1分配。相反地，二元杂物场景中任意数量代理人都可实现更强的EFX+EQX保证，即使没有归一化。论文还首次研究了跨概念的ex-ante与ex-post保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公平分配研究要么关注同时满足相近的公平概念，要么在ex-ante和ex-post世界中实现单一概念。本文旨在探索两种根本不同的公平概念（无嫉妒与公平性）之间的兼容性，填补了这一交叉领域的研究空白。

Method: 论文通过理论分析和算法设计研究EF1+EQ1、EFX+EQX等组合公平概念的可行性。对于二元商品场景设计了计算EF1+EQ1分配的算法（至多七人），并在二元杂物场景中证明了更强的EFX+EQX可行性；同时初步探索随机化的跨概念ex-ante-ex-post保证。

Result: (1) 即使归一化可加性估值下，EF1+EQ1可能不存在；(2) 归一化二元商品在至多七人时可计算EF1+EQ1分配；(3) 二元杂物场景对任意数量代理人都存在EFX+EQX保证，且无需归一化；(4) 两种场景呈现鲜明对比。

Conclusion: 商品与杂物两种设置在同时满足无嫉妒和公平性放松概念时的可行性存在鲜明对比：商品场景更困难（EF1+EQ1都未必存在），而杂物场景则能实现更强的EFX+EQX。论文同时开启了跨概念ex-ante-ex-post保证这一新的研究方向。

Abstract: Recent work in fair division has focused on either simultaneously satisfying closely related fairness notions or achieving a single notion across the ex-ante and ex-post worlds. We study the compatibility of two fundamentally different fairness notions: envy-freeness and equitability. For indivisible goods-only and chores-only settings, we study the existence and complexity of simultaneously satisfying their relaxations, revealing sharp contrasts between the two settings. We show that EF1+EQ1 may fail to exist even for normalized, additive valuations. Our main algorithmic result computes an EF1+EQ1 allocation for normalized binary goods with at most seven agents. In sharp contrast, binary chores admit the stronger EFX+EQX guarantee for any number of agents, even without normalization. We further initiate the study of cross-notion ex-ante--ex-post guarantees, asking whether randomized allocations can provide ex-ante guarantees for one notion while preserving ex-post guarantees for another.

</details>


### [305] [Trusting AI in Competitive Markets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26539)
*Jussi Keppo,Yuze Li,Gerry Tsoukalas,Nuo Yuan*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 通过实验室实验（273名卖家、91个三卖家市场、30轮），研究了在寡头定价中AI建议的信任分化如何受市场性别构成影响。研究发现女性-only市场中AI建议使价格提高29%、利润提高39%，而男性和混合市场中无显著效果。使用非齐次隐马尔可夫模型揭示了"女性市场盈利促进信任增强、其他市场反之"的学习模式，与自我归因偏差一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人们对AI建议的信任在使用过程中出现分化——有人加深、有人消退。在寡头定价情境中，建议无法自我证明价值，因为竞争对手的反应决定了建议是否奏效。现有关于性别与AI的证据无法预测这种分化，因此需要探究市场性别构成如何塑造卖家从建议中学习的过程。

Method: 实验室实验：273名卖家在91个三卖家市场中进行30轮竞争；操纵因素包括AI定价建议的有无和市场性别构成（女性-only、男性-only、混合）。数据分析采用非齐次隐马尔可夫模型（Non-Homogeneous Hidden Markov Model）来捕捉建议遵循度的动态变化及其与盈利结果的关联。

Result: 在女性-only市场中，AI建议使价格提高29%、利润提高39%；在男性-only和混合市场中无显著效果。隐马尔可夫模型显示组成特异性的动态关联：盈利轮次预测女性市场中建议遵循度上升，而在其他市场中遵循度下降——这一模式与习得信任和自我归因偏差（self-serving attribution）一致。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了AI建议效果受市场性别构成调节，且模式与近期关于性别与AI的现有证据相反。管理启示在于平台治理和监管监督不仅要关注算法本身，还应关注塑造其效应的人类因素（市场参与者与互动结构）。

Abstract: Problem definition: People's trust in AI advice diverges as they use it, deepening for some and eroding for others. We study this divergence in oligopoly pricing, where advice cannot prove itself: rivals' responses decide whether it pays off. Methodology/results: In a laboratory experiment, 273 sellers compete across 91 three-seller markets over 30 rounds; we vary the presence of AI pricing recommendations and the gender composition of the market (female-only, male-only, or mixed). We find that the gender composition of the market shapes how sellers learn from the advice, and where prices settle as a result. In female-only markets, recommendations raise prices by 29% and profits by 39%; in male-only and mixed-gender markets, they have no significant effect. A Non-Homogeneous Hidden Markov Model reveals a composition-specific dynamic association: profitable rounds predict rising adherence to the AI in female-only markets and declining adherence otherwise, a pattern consistent with learned trust and self-serving attribution. The pattern reverses what recent evidence on gender and AI would predict. Managerial implications: We discuss implications for platform governance and regulatory oversight, which should focus not only on the algorithm but on the human side that shapes its effects.

</details>


### [306] [A lone divider allocation algorithm with subjective divisibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26801)
*Uriel Feige*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究主观可分分配模型中的最大最小份额（MMS）分配问题，将此前已知的5/9-MMS分配存在性提升至3/5-MMS分配的存在性，证明基于对"独裁分割者"（lone divider）框架的改编。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在主观可分分配模型中，货物既可以是完全可分的，也可以是"原子性"的（小于1的部分价值为零）。此前已有工作证明了5/9-MMS分配的存在性，但这一结果是否可以进一步改进尚不清楚。提升MMS近似比是公平分配领域的核心目标之一。

Method: 作者改编了经典的"lone divider"（独裁分割者）框架来证明3/5-MMS分配的存在性。该框架通过让一个"分割者"将商品划分为若干份，并由其他参与者在可接受份额中选择，从而构造满足MMS近似保证的分配方案。

Result: 证明了在主观可分分配模型中，3/5-MMS分配总是存在，将此前已知的5/9-MMS结果予以改进。

Conclusion: 通过改编lone divider框架，成功将主观可分分配模型中的MMS近似比从5/9提升到3/5，这是该方向上的一项实质性改进。

Abstract: In the subjective divisibility allocation model, all goods are divisible, every agent $i$ has a non-negative additive valuation function $v_i$, where for some goods $v_i$ is additive over fractions of the good, and for some goods, any fraction smaller than~1 has value~0. Previous work established the existence of $\frac{5}{9}$-MMS allocations in this setting. We show that $\frac{3}{5}$-MMS allocations exist. Our proof is based on an adaptation of the lone divider framework.

</details>


### [307] [Robust Lottery Compression for Metric Voting: A Transfer Principle for Bounded Randomness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26854)
*Jianhao Jia,Bo Peng*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究随机社会选择中的度量失真问题，在"有界随机性"约束下（规则必须确定性地选出K个候选然后均匀随机选择），证明了对于任意K≥802，存在失真度不超过5/2 + O(K^{-1/3})的规则，逼近当前最优无约束基准5/2。核心贡献是一个无维度压缩定理，并给出了打破确定性3失真障碍所需最小列表大小的界2≤N*≤164。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往研究表明有界随机性模型可以优于确定性失真3的基准，作者希望进一步证明该受限模型可以达到当前最优无约束上界5/2，从而缩小受限与无约束模型之间的性能差距。

Method: 主要技术贡献是无维度压缩定理：如果彩票的失真至多为ρ且其支撑中每个候选的确定性失真至多为H，则存在均匀K条目逼近，其失真至多为ρ+(H+1)√(π/(8K))。由于Mixed Integrated Veto不满足该支撑条件，作者先移除早期淘汰的结果，用O(τ²)的失真损失换取所有支撑候选的O(1/τ)确定性失真上界，通过平衡修复成本与压缩成本得到O(K^{-1/3})收敛率。

Result: 证明了对于每个K≥802，存在失真至多5/2 + 3(π/8K)^{1/3} + 2√(π/8K)的有界随机性规则；O(ε^{-3})个条目即可实现5/2+ε的失真，与选民和候选人数无关；164个条目即可实现严格低于3的失真，给出2≤N*≤164的界限。

Conclusion: 有界随机性模型可以有效逼近无约束随机社会选择的最优性能，通过维度无关的压缩定理克服了维度灾难，但收敛率为O(K^{-1/3})而非期望的O(K^{-1/2})，仍有改进空间。

Abstract: We study metric distortion in randomized social choice under bounded randomness: on every preference profile, the voting rule must deterministically identify a multiset of $K$ candidates and then select a uniformly random entry. Previous work showed that this restricted model can beat the optimal deterministic distortion of $3$. We show that it can in fact approach the current best unrestricted upper benchmark of $5/2$. For every integer $K\ge 802$, there exists a bounded-randomness rule with distortion at most $\frac{5}{2} +3\left(\fracπ{8K}\right)^{1/3} +2\sqrt{\fracπ{8K}}$.
  Consequently, $O(\varepsilon^{-3})$ entries suffice for distortion $5/2+\varepsilon$, independently of the numbers of voters and candidates. We also show that $164$ entries already achieve distortion strictly below $3$, giving $2\le N^\star\le 164$ for the minimum list size needed to break the deterministic barrier. Our main technical contribution is a dimension-free compression theorem: if a lottery has distortion at most $ρ$ and every candidate in its support has deterministic distortion at most $H$, then it admits a uniform $K$-entry approximation with distortion at most $ρ+(H+1)\sqrt{π/(8K)}$. Thus, lotteries whose possible outcomes are already well behaved incur only $O(K^{-1/2})$ compression loss. Mixed Integrated Veto does not satisfy this support condition, so we first remove early-eliminated outcomes, trading $O(τ^2)$ distortion loss for an $O(1/τ)$ bound on the deterministic distortion of every supported candidate. Balancing this repair cost against compression yields the $O(K^{-1/3})$ convergence rate.

</details>


### [308] [Blindfolded pursuit with delays of your choice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27347)
*Torben Schürenberg,Maximilian J. Stahlberg*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究图上单追捕者与不可见逃逸者的追逃博弈，证明当追捕者可以为边分配整数旅行时间时，在两种设置（猎人-兔子游戏和救火游戏）下均可在多项式时间内单追捕者获胜于任意图；若逃逸者可提前未知时间出发，追捕者仍可在指数时间内获胜。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典的追捕-逃逸博弈（如猎人-兔子游戏、救火游戏）在无权图中需要线性数量的猎人/消防员才能覆盖某些图，而本研究探索是否可以通过赋予追捕者选择边旅行时间（加权）的权力，用单个追捕者在任意图上高效获胜，从而解决单代理高效性这一关键问题。

Method: 作者研究两种博弈设置：(1) 逃逸者每时间步必须移动（猎人-兔子游戏）；(2) 逃逸者可在顶点等待（可等价为救火游戏）。核心方法是允许追捕者为图的边分配整数旅行时间，并设计一个有限顶点查询序列，使得在任何图上都能以单追捕者在多项式时间内捕获不可见逃逸者。对于逃逸者可从更早未知时间出发的变体，证明追捕者在指数时间内仍能获胜。

Result: 1) 在两种主要设置（必须移动和可等待）下，赋予追捕者选择边旅行时间的权力，即可在任意图上用单追捕者在多项式时间内获胜，与无权图需要线性数量追捕者形成鲜明对比。2) 当逃逸者还可提前于未知时间出发时，追捕者仍可在任意图上于指数时间内获胜。

Conclusion: 赋予追捕者分配边旅行时间的权力是一种强大而普适的工具，可将无权图中需要多个追捕者的难题转化为单追捕者的多项式时间可解问题；即使面对更困难的时间偏移变体，单追捕者的指数时间策略仍然完备。

Abstract: We study pursuit-evasion games on graphs with a single pursuer and an invisible evader. The pursuer may assign integer travel times to the edges of the graph and specify a finite sequence of vertices to query, one per time step. The evader then chooses a walk over the same time horizon, aiming to elude all queries. With unit travel times, the setting in which the evader must move at every time step is known as the hunter and rabbit game, while the variant in which the evader can wait at a vertex can be phrased as a firefighting game: the vertices of a burning graph must be extinguished, and any vertex left burning reignites its neighbors. For both settings, we show that the power to choose travel times allows a single pursuer to succeed in polynomial time on any graph. This contrasts with unweighted graphs, where the number of hunters or firefighters needed can grow linearly in the number of vertices. If the evader, in addition to waiting, may start at an earlier time unknown to the pursuer, we show that the pursuer still wins on any graph given exponential time.

</details>


### [309] [Token-Level Advertising](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27382)
*Hanbing Liu,Bowei Zhang,Changyuan Yu,Yinyu Ye,Qi Qi*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文提出LAMA（潜广告主混合拍卖），一种令牌级广告机制，将广告主影响力直接嵌入大模型的生成过程中，通过潜混合解码与分配后验更新实现生成原生的广告形式，满足马尔可夫DSIC和IR，并在真实商业搜索数据上验证了其可行性与有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI正在改变人们获取信息的方式，传统的基于预定义广告位的广告机制已经不再适用。为了适配生成式AI的原生广告需求，需要一种新的机制设计，让广告主的影响力直接嵌入生成过程而非插入固定槽位。

Method: 提出LAMA机制：广告主报告局部续值（local continuation values），诱导生成广告主特定的下一令牌策略；平台通过潜混合（latent mixture）解码并更新分配后验。证明了该机制满足马尔可夫DSIC和IR，并达到近最优的KL正则化福利。进一步开发了基于学习的实现方法，在线从学习到的局部优势和根值重建所需报告。

Result: 在真实商业搜索查询分割上的概念验证实验表明，LAMA在保持用户端响应质量的同时提升了平台福利和收入，为生成原生广告的可行性提供了初步证据。

Conclusion: LAMA展示了生成原生广告的可行路径，通过在令牌级别整合广告主偏好，在不损害用户体验的前提下改善平台经济效益，为未来生成式AI环境下的广告机制设计提供了新的方向。

Abstract: Generative AI is transforming how people access information, challenging traditional advertising mechanisms built around predefined slots. Towards generation-native advertising, we propose the Latent Advertiser Mixture Auction (LAMA), a token-level advertising mechanism that embeds advertiser influence directly into the generation process. Advertisers report local continuation values that induce advertiser-specific next-token policies, from which the platform decodes through a latent mixture while updating an allocation posterior. We show that LAMA satisfies Markov DSIC and IR, and achieves near-optimal KL-regularized welfare. We further develop a learning-based implementation that reconstructs the required reports online from learned local advantages and root values. Proof-of-concept experiments on real-world commercial-search query splits show that LAMA improves platform welfare and revenue while maintaining user-facing response quality, providing initial evidence for the feasibility of generation-native advertising.

</details>


### [310] [Algorithms for Robbins' Problem using Markov Decision Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27419)
*Léonard Brice,F. Thomas Bruss,Anirban Majumdar,Jean-François Raskin*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究Robbins问题（秘书问题的完全信息变体），目标是最小化选中候选人的期望排名。作者将Robbins问题建模为无限马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），提出多种有限状态抽象来近似求解，并首次给出了n=5到100的近似值，填补了此前空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Robbins问题是最小化期望排名的秘书选择问题变体，其精确值仅在n≤4时已知，而此前的数值近似仅覆盖了个位数的小n值。由于问题需要记忆所有过往候选人的值才能达到最优，分析极具挑战性，因此需要新的方法为更大的n提供近似解。

Method: 作者首先将Robbins问题建模为无限状态MDP，然后提出多种有限状态抽象来近似这些MDP的值。关键在于识别出简单的记忆结构足以获得近似最优的选择策略，尽管完整的记忆在理论上是最优所必需的。

Result: 对于所有5≤n≤100的n值，作者给出了比以往任何已知结果都更好的近似值。这些n值此前没有好的近似结果。

Conclusion: 通过有限状态抽象MDP的方法，成功获得了Robbins问题在更大n范围内的高质量近似值，证明了简单的记忆结构在实践上足以达到接近最优的性能。

Abstract: In this paper, we consider Robbins' problem, which is a full information variant of the well-known secretary selection problem. In this version of the problem, the goal is to minimize the expected rank of the selected candidate among $n$ that are interviewed sequentially, and a decision to select or not the $m^{th}$ candidate needs to be taken right after the interview (so without seeing the last $n-m$ candidates and without recall). We first show how to model instances of Robbins' problem as infinite Markov Decision Processes (MDPs). Then we propose several finite-state abstractions of these MDPs that allow us to approximate the value of the problem for fixed $n$. While it is known that the full memory of past candidates' values is necessary for optimal expected rank minimization, making the analysis of the problem challenging, we highlight simple memory structures that are sufficient for obtaining near-optimal selection strategies. Additionally, we provide approximate values for Robbins' problem for numbers of candidates $n$ up to 100 for which no good approximations were previously known (the exact value is only known for instances where $n \leq 4$ and numerical approximations were for small values of $n$ not exceeding one digit), for all $n : 5 \leq n \leq 100$, we give better approximation than what was previously known.

</details>

### [311] [Bug Localization from Bug Reports: A Multi-Objective Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27089)
*Waleed Ahmad,Mehtab Kiran Suddle,Maryam Bashir*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于多目标搜索的类级别自动化 bug 定位系统，使用 SPEA-2 进化算法在最大化相似度的同时最小化建议的故障文件数量，在六个开源 Java 项目和 22,000 多个 bug 报告中取得了优于 NSGA-II 和 MOEA/D 的效果，并验证了其在 Kotlin 工业项目中的跨语言适应性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Bug 定位是大规模软件系统中耗时费力的任务。现有研究大多局限于单一目标定位方法且受限于特定编程语言，同时仅依赖源代码与 bug 报告之间的词汇相似度往往不够充分，因为 bug 描述具有自然语言特性。

Method: 提出一个类级别的自动化多目标搜索系统，使用 SPEA-2 进化优化算法，核心目标是在最大化相似度的同时最小化建议的故障文件数量。在六个开源 Java 项目（超过22,000个bug报告）上进行评估，并与 NSGA-II 和 MOEA/D 两种广泛使用的算法进行对比。

Result: SPEA-2 在精确率和召回率上均优于多目标和单目标基线方法。该系统成功在 top-10 推荐中定位了88.5%的bug报告对应类，在 top-20 中达到94%。此外，在 Kotlin 编写的工业 Android 项目上验证了模型的有效性，证明了其跨编程语言的适应能力。

Conclusion: 多目标进化算法 SPEA-2 在 bug 定位任务上表现优异，能够有效平衡相似度最大化与推荐文件数量最小化之间的冲突，且方法具备跨编程语言的通用性。

Abstract: Bug localization is a labor-intensive task, particularly in large software systems. When abnormal behavior occurs, developers must perform repetitive and time-consuming steps to identify faulty files. Previous studies have mainly focused on single-objective localization methods, many of which are limited to specific programming languages. In addition, relying solely on lexical similarity between source code and bug reports is often insufficient due to the natural language nature of bug descriptions. In this study, we propose a class-level automated multi-objective search-based system to identify and rank potentially buggy classes from bug reports. The main objective is to maximize similarity while minimizing the number of suggested faulty files. The evolutionary optimization algorithm SPEA-2 was applied to six open-source Java projects comprising more than 22,000 bug reports. The proposed approach was evaluated against two widely used algorithms, NSGA-II and MOEA/D. Results indicate that SPEA-2 achieved higher precision and recall than both multi-objective and single-objective baseline methods. The proposed recommender system successfully identified buggy classes or files for 88.5\% of bug reports within the top 10 recommendations and 94\% within the top 20. The effectiveness of the model was further validated on an industrial Android project written in Kotlin, demonstrating its adaptability across programming languages.

</details>


### [312] [ANTShapes Benchmarking Datasets for Event-Based Neuromorphic Object Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27150)
*M. Middleton,H. Kayan,B. Sen Bhattacharya,T. Ali,E. Baikas,M. Vousden,C. Perera,O. Rhodes,E. Gheorghiu,M. A. Trefzer*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文针对事件相机视觉中的目标分类任务，提出了四个基于ANTShapes仿真工具生成的新数据集，并使用卷积脉冲神经网络（SNN）对其进行基准测试，与N-MNIST、CIFAR10-DVS等现有脉冲数据集进行对比验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于帧的相机在极端边缘部署中存在尺寸、重量和功耗问题，且云端计算存在安全、延迟和连接性隐患。事件相机结合SNN可解决这些问题，但缺乏高质量的事件视觉数据集阻碍了研究进展。

Method: 使用ANTShapes仿真工具生成四个难度递增的新数据集，采用卷积SNN进行分类，并与N-MNIST、CIFAR10-DVS、DVSGesture和POKER-DVS等现有基准数据集进行对比评测。

Result: 提供了四个包含丰富细节的新数据集供未来实验使用，同时验证了ANTShapes数据仿真工具输出的适用性。

Conclusion: 该工作一方面为事件视觉研究提供了四个新的基准数据集，另一方面确认了ANTShapes工具能够有效生成高质量的事件视觉数据集，为缺乏数据的该领域研究提供了可靠的数据生成方案。

Abstract: Object classification in event-based computer vision is a task that is attracting considerable research attention. Event-based object classification is a fundamental task in the fields of security and applied computer vision, which typically use synchronous frame-based cameras and computing pipelines for operation. This approach has several practical flaws. The size, weight and power consumption of the device could prohibit deployment at the extreme edge or in covert sensing environments. Besides this, there are security concerns inherent in cloud-based or other off-device computation approaches due to the requirement of sending and receiving potentially sensitive data. Furthermore, this transmission of data introduces latency and requires consistent connectivity to the cloud infrastructure to function.
  The use of Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) hosted on neuromorphic devices attempts to solve several issues present in this conventional approach. Research into event-based object classification methods are hindered by the lack of high-quality vision datasets to use. To this end, the ANTShapes simulation tool has been previously proposed to create and label event-based vision datasets. In this paper, four novel datasets of varying difficulties are created using the tool and are benchmarked against existing spiking datasets commonly used for event-based vision research (N-MNIST, CIFAR10-DVS, DVSGesture and POKER-DVS). Classification is performed using a convolutional SNN. This work simultaneously provides four datasets with rich details for future experiments to use and validates the output of the ANTShapes dataset simulation tool as being suitable for its purpose.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [313] [EduRiskX: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework with F-Logic Reasoning for Early Academic Risk Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26107)
*Yu Fu,Yongqi Kang,Yong Zhao,Rongfang Bie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出EduRiskX，一种神经符号框架，结合时间Transformer预测器与F-Logic符号推理，用于在线教育中学生学业风险的早期检测与可解释预测。在OULAD数据集上达到0.900准确率和0.894 F1分数，平均早期检测周数为9.32，检测率达94.30%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学业风险预测模型存在两个关键问题：早期检测能力有限以及可解释性不足，导致"黑箱"信任危机，阻碍了模型在实际教学场景中的采用。作者希望构建一个既能早期准确预测风险、又能提供可解释依据的框架。

Method: EduRiskX采用神经符号混合架构：1）神经组件使用基于时间注意力的Transformer对纵向学生活动序列建模，结合类别加权损失和动态周截断；2）符号组件基于教学理论（参与理论和学生整合模型）构建F-Logic规则库作为数据驱动的专家系统；3）通过逻辑回归融合机制组合神经风险概率与符号置信度分数。

Result: 在OULAD数据集上采用严格的80/10/10学生级划分，EduRiskX在第38周达到0.900准确率和0.894 F1分数，平均早期检测周为9.32，检测率达94.30%。与PatchTST、iTransformer等SOTA时间序列模型及LSTM、CNN等深度学习基线相比，在相同条件下获得了更好的召回率和更早的风险识别。

Conclusion: EduRiskX不仅提升了早期检测性能和预测精度，还通过F-Logic模块提供结构化的基于规则的解忆，将预测结果与可观察的行为模式和教学理论联系起来，解决了黑箱信任危机问题。

Abstract: Predicting students' academic risk in online education is crucial for enabling timely interventions that can improve retention and learning outcomes. However, existing models often suffer from limited early detection capability and insufficient interpretability, leading to a "black-box" trust crisis that hinders their adoption in real-world pedagogical settings. To address these challenges, we propose EduRiskX, a neuro-symbolic framework that integrates a temporal Transformer-based predictor with F-Logic symbolic reasoning. The neural component models longitudinal student activity sequences using temporal attention, class-weighted loss, and dynamic weekly truncation. Acting as a data-driven expert system, an F-Logic rule base -- grounded in established educational theories (Engagement Theory and Student Integration Model) to mimic the diagnostic logic of human educators -- is constructed exclusively from the training data. The neural risk probability and the symbolic confidence score are then combined through a logistic regression-based fusion mechanism that learns the relative contribution of each signal. Experiments on the Open University Learning Analytics Dataset (OULAD) using a strict 80/10/10 student-level split show that EduRiskX achieves an accuracy of 0.900 and an F1-score of 0.894 at the end of the semester (Week 38), with an average early detection week of 9.32 and a detection rate of 94.30 percent. Compared with state-of-the-art time-series models (PatchTST, iTransformer) and common deep learning baselines (LSTM, CNN), EduRiskX yields improved recall and earlier risk identification under identical conditions. Beyond predictive performance, the F-Logic module provides structured rule-based explanations linking predictions to observable behavioral patterns and educational theories.

</details>


### [314] [Standalone LLM and a Pre-specified Agentic Pipeline for Explaining ICU Mortality Predictions: a Feasibility Study on the eICU Demo Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26109)
*Di Zhu,Chen Xie,Haoyun Zhang,Zihan Wei,Ziwei Wang,Jiazhao Shi,Ziyu Wang,Qiyang Xie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是对ICU死亡率预测解释系统的可行性随访研究，比较了独立LLM与四步agentic管道在临床解释生成上的表现。XGBoost模型AUROC为0.855，agentic管道在安全性（无结果泄漏）、指南接地性和临床合理性上优于独立LLM，但在SHAP特征对齐和方向一致性上不如独立LLM，提示agentic分解应与归因验证结合使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习模型能准确预测ICU死亡率，但传统的特征归因方法（如SHAP）难以提供临床诊疗所需的叙述性解释。LLM可能弥合这一差距，而多步agentic管道通过分离数据解读、指南检查和最终解释三个环节，被视为一种可行的扩展方案。本研究旨在验证独立LLM与agentic管道在临床解释生成上的性能差异。

Method: 使用eICU Demo数据集（2,353例ICU停留，死亡率8.1%），XGBoost模型达到AUROC 0.855。在38例分层解释子集上，比较独立LLM与四步agentic管道在结果泄漏、SHAP对齐（Jaccard系数）、方向一致性、指南接地性、数值特异性和临床合理性等指标上的表现。

Result: XGBoost AUROC 0.855（95% CI 0.796-0.906），AUPRC 0.332。独立LLM产生1例明确结果泄漏，agentic管道为0例。在14例重叠案例中，独立LLM的SHAP对齐（Jaccard 0.171 vs 0.077）和方向一致性（92.9% vs 78.6%）更高，但agentic管道在指南接地性（0.762 vs 0.143）、数值特异性（0.236 vs 0.143）和临床合理性（0.700 vs 0.671）上更好。

Conclusion: Agentic分解可能提升安全相关的临床接地性和患者特异性细节，但在高风险风险解释应用前，应结合基于归因的验证检查，以平衡临床叙述质量与特征归因保真度。

Abstract: Machine-learning models can predict ICU mortality accurately, but feature-attribution methods alone rarely provide the clinical narrative needed for bedside use. Large language models (LLMs) may bridge this gap, and multi-step agentic pipelines are a plausible extension because they separate data interpretation, guideline checking, and final explanation. This revised feasibility study preserves the original standalone-versus-agentic comparison while making the main clinical findings more explicit. Using the retained local eICU Demo artifact set (2,353 ICU stays; 8.1\% mortality), XGBoost achieved an AUROC of 0.855 (95\% CI 0.796--0.906) and an AUPRC of 0.332 (95\% CI 0.217--0.494). On a stratified 38-case explanation subset, the standalone LLM produced 1 explanation with explicit outcome leakage, whereas the four-step agentic pipeline produced none. Among the 14 cases that overlapped with the SHAP review subset, the standalone LLM showed higher SHAP alignment (mean Jaccard 0.171 versus 0.077) and higher direction consistency (92.9\% versus 78.6\%), while the agentic pipeline showed higher guideline grounding (0.762 versus 0.143), higher value specificity (0.236 versus 0.143), and slightly higher plausibility (0.700 versus 0.671). Clinically, the results suggest that agentic decomposition may improve safety-relevant grounding and patient-specific detail, but it should be paired with attribution-based checks before use in high-stakes risk explanation.

</details>


### [315] [Large Models for Battery Prognostics and Health Management: A Review and Future Roadmap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26111)
*Jiale Liu,Huan Wang,Weicheng Wang,Rong Zhu,Qiqi Wang,Min Xie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是首个全面综述大型模型（LMs）在电池健康与故障预测管理（BPHM）中应用的系统性调查，涵盖Transformer架构、自监督预训练、PEFT等基础技术，并从数据稀缺缓解、泛化与鲁棒性增强、领域知识融合的可解释性、系统级自动化四个维度分类综述现有进展，最后提出协作数据生态、工业智能验证、可信物理融合设计和高效率端侧部署的研究路线图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统BPHM方法（基于物理模型和任务特定深度学习方法）面临计算效率低、参数化困难、跨域泛化能力差、依赖大量标注的run-to-failure数据以及可解释性不足等长期瓶颈，亟需探索新的范式来突破这些挑战。

Method: 系统性地对大型模型在BPHM中的应用进行综述：首先阐明支撑LMs的基础技术（Transformer架构、自监督学习、大规模多模态数据集、PEFT技术），然后沿四个关键维度分类分析最新进展，最后识别现存挑战并提出未来研究路线图。

Result: 综述表明LMs在缓解数据稀缺、增强泛化与鲁棒性、融合领域知识实现可解释性以及支持系统级自动化方面展现出显著潜力，但同时在数据可获取性、智能验证、可信度与部署可行性方面仍存在重大挑战。

Conclusion: 大型模型为BPHM提供了变革性的新范式，能够克服传统方法的长期瓶颈；未来研究应聚焦于构建协作数据生态、面向工业应用的智能验证、物理信息驱动的可信设计以及高效端侧部署，以推动下一代具备安全、可靠、自主运行的电池管理系统发展。

Abstract: Battery Prognostics and Health Management (BPHM) is critical for ensuring the safe, reliable, and cost-effective operation of batteries across electric vehicles, grid storage, and consumer electronics. Conventional BPHM approaches, including physics-based models and task-centric deep learning methods, face challenges in computational efficiency and parameterization, cross-domain generalization, dependence on extensive labeled run-to-failure data, and model interpretability. Recent Large Models (LMs), built upon Transformer architectures and self-supervised pre-training, offer a transformative new paradigm to overcome these long-standing bottlenecks. This review provides the first comprehensive survey of LM applications in BPHM, systematically examining how these models address challenges in the field. We begin by elucidating the foundational technologies enabling LMs, including Transformer architectures, self-supervised learning, large-scale multimodal datasets, and PEFT techniques. We then categorize recent progress along four critical dimensions: mitigating data scarcity, enhancing generalization and robustness, integrating domain knowledge for interpretability, and enabling system-level automation. Despite promising results, significant challenges remain across data accessibility, intelligence validation, trustworthiness, and deployment feasibility. To guide future research, we propose a roadmap focused on building collaborative data ecosystems, validating intelligence for industrial applications, enhancing trustworthiness with physics-informed designs, and enabling efficient on-device deployment. This review establishes a systematic approach to understand and advance LM-driven BPHM, providing researchers and practitioners with essential insights for developing next-generation battery management systems capable of safe, reliable, and autonomous operation throughout battery lifecycles.

</details>


### [316] [PICasso: An AI-Enabled Design Framework for Autonomous Optimization of Silicon Photonic Devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26113)
*Deepak Vungarala,Deniz Najafi,Abdulrahman Aljoudi,Zahra Ghanaatian,Navid Khoshavi,Gourav Datta,Arman Roohi,Mahdi Nikdast,Shaahin Angizi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出PICasso，一个AI辅助框架，用于从自然语言规范自动合成、验证和优化光子集成电路（PICs）。同时引入PIC-Set基准（36个参数化PIC设计任务）来系统评估AI驱动的光子设计。实验表明PICasso显著优于vanilla LLM生成，结构Spec@3高达92.7%，功能Spec@3达52%，平均插入损耗从4.98dB降至3.25dB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光子集成电路设计传统上依赖手动GUI工作流，耗时且复杂。虽然LLM在代码生成方面表现出色，但直接用于PIC设计时缺乏领域知识、物理验证和制造可行性约束，导致生成的电路布局往往无法实际制造或功能不达标。

Method: PICasso采用结构化NL→YAML→GDS生成流水线，结合PDK感知知识注入、自动布局布线、DRC/LVS验证以及基于SAX的光子仿真。同时提出PIC-Set基准和统一评估协议，包含结构/功能Spec@k、优化效率和扰动鲁棒性等新指标。

Result: 在PIC-Set基准上，PICasso结构Spec@3高达92.7%，功能Spec@3达52%（高复杂度电路）；通过仿真引导优化将平均插入损耗从4.98dB降至3.25dB，提升1.74dB。

Conclusion: 结构化领域约束、物理验证和仿真反馈能使LLM从脆弱的网表生成器转变为实用的PIC设计智能体，能够生成可制造的版图，且运行时间与手动GUI工作流相比具有竞争力。

Abstract: We present PICasso, an AI-assisted framework for automated synthesis, verification, and optimization of photonic integrated circuits (PICs) from natural-language specifications. PICasso couples a structured NL -> YAML -> GDS generation pipeline with PDK aware knowledge injection, automated placement and routing, DRC/LVS validation, and SAX-based photonic simulation. To systematically evaluate AI-driven photonic design, we introduce PIC-Set, a benchmark of 36 parameterized PIC design tasks spanning core photonic primitives and multi-component circuits. Using PIC-Set, we benchmark several state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs) under a unified evaluation protocol, including new metrics such as structural and functional $Spec@k$, optimization efficiency, and robustness under perturbations. Across the benchmark, PICasso significantly improves end-to-end specification satisfaction compared to vanilla LLM generation. Structural $Spec@3$ reaches up to 92.7% and functional $Spec@3$ up to 52% on high-complexity circuits. In addition, PICasso consistently reduces circuit insertion loss, lowering the mean loss from 4.98 dB to 3.25 dB (1.74 dB improvement) through simulation-guided optimization. These results demonstrate that structured domain constraints, physical verification, and simulation feedback transform LLMs from brittle netlist generators into practical PIC design agents capable of producing manufacturable layouts with competitive runtimes relative to manual GUI-based workflows.

</details>


### [317] [CIFQA: A Deterministic Tool-Grounded Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Financial Query Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26114)
*Kunjesh Parekh,Anil Kumar Tiwari,Divya Saxena*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CIFQA是一个确定性工具grounded的多智能体LLM框架，用于计算密集型的金融问答任务。它将语言理解与数值执行分离，通过专门的智能体处理查询解释、路由、参数提取、计算规划和响应生成，同时使用确定性Python工具执行金融计算。在固定存款查询基准上达到95.54%的计算密集型问题准确率和90.87%的整体准确率，远超直接使用LLM的基线方法。消融研究表明确定性组件是关键贡献因素，且17B开源模型在框架内表现优于更大规模的前沿模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在自然语言任务上表现强劲，但在多步金融计算中常产生数值错误但看似合理的答案。计算密集型金融问答需要精确推理结构化利率、时间条件、数值公式和规则约束，而现有LLM缺乏这种确定性推理能力。

Method: 提出CIFQA框架：采用多智能体架构，将语言理解与数值执行分离。配备查询解释、路由、参数提取、计算规划和响应生成等专用智能体，金融计算和规则应用由确定性Python工具完成。在固定存款问答场景上实例化该框架，并构建基准数据集进行评测。

Result: 在计算密集型查询上达到95.54%准确率，整体准确率90.87%，显著优于直接LLM基线。消融实验表明精确利率查询、存期计算、滚动年调整和提前支取逻辑等确定性组件是关键贡献。17B参数的开源模型在CIFQA框架内超越更大规模前沿模型。

Conclusion: 架构设计比模型规模更能决定数值可靠性，CIFQA将语言与数值执行分离的设计原则为计算密集型金融推理提供了通用可扩展的解决方案。虽然当前在固定存款领域验证，但框架具有跨金融场景的泛化潜力。

Abstract: Calculation-intensive financial question answering requires exact reasoning over structured rates, temporal conditions, numerical formulas, and rule-based constraints. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) perform strongly on natural language tasks, they often produce numerically incorrect yet plausible answers when solving multi-step financial calculations. To address this limitation, we introduce CIFQA (Calculation-Intensive Financial Query Answering), a deterministic tool-grounded multi-agent LLM framework for financial question answering. CIFQA separates language understanding from numerical execution by assigning specialized agents to query interpretation, routing, parameter extraction, computation planning, and response generation, while deterministic Python-based tools perform financial calculations and rule application. We instantiate CIFQA for fixed deposit query answering and evaluate it on a curated benchmark of fixed deposit queries. CIFQA achieves 95.54% accuracy on calculation-intensive queries and 90.87% overall accuracy, substantially outperforming direct LLM baselines even when provided with complete formulas, rate cards, and benchmark instructions. Ablation studies show that deterministic components such as exact rate lookup, tenure computation, rolling-year adjustment, and premature-withdrawal logic are critical contributors to performance. Notably, a 17B open-source backbone operating within CIFQA outperforms substantially larger frontier models evaluated with the same financial information, demonstrating that architectural design is a more important determinant of numerical reliability than model scale. While evaluated on fixed deposit queries, CIFQA provides a generalizable framework for calculation-intensive financial reasoning tasks.

</details>


### [318] [The Artificial Experimentalist: Discovery and Control of Self-Organizing Phenomena with Autotelic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26116)
*Marko Cvjetko,Benedikt Hartl,Michael Levin,Clément Moulin-Frier,Pierre-Yves Oudeyer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于自生成目标强化学习（autotelic RL）的闭环框架CARL，用于通过最小局部扰动干预复杂系统（如Lenia连续元胞自动机）。CARL能够发现稳定孤子、控制孤子运动方向，并支持人类通过高层指令实时引导孤子穿越迷宫，且在多种分布外条件下具备零样本泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有探索元胞自动机等复杂系统的方法多为开环操作：设置初始条件、执行完整模拟、观察结果，无法在运行过程中进行干预。这种范式限制了发现和控制涌现现象的能力，因此需要一种闭环、可干预的智能体框架。

Method: 基于自生成目标强化学习（autotelic RL）构建闭环框架，智能体自主采样多样化目标并学习目标条件策略，通过最小局部扰动干预复杂系统。在Lenia（连续元胞自动机）上实例化为CARL系统，训练时覆盖多样化目标、更新规则和随机初始状态，使策略具备零样本泛化能力。

Result: CARL在三个方面展现了能力：（1）在广泛的Lenia更新规则中以高于启发式基线的方法发现稳定孤子；（2）以较少干预学会操控现有孤子的运动方向；（3）人类可通过高层方向指令实时引导孤子穿越迷宫。智能体策略可零样本泛化到多种分布外条件。

Conclusion: 该工作展示了一条通往"人工实验者"智能体的路径，这类智能体能够自主或在人类引导下发现和控制复杂系统中的涌现现象，为复杂系统探索提供了闭环干预的新范式。

Abstract: Existing methods for exploring cellular automata and other complex systems mostly operate in open loop: they set initial conditions, execute a full simulation, and observe the outcome, without intervening during execution. We introduce a closed-loop framework based on autotelic reinforcement learning, in which an agent autonomously samples diverse goals and learns a goal-conditioned policy to intervene in a complex system through minimal, local perturbations. We instantiate this framework on Lenia, a continuous cellular automaton known for life-like self-organizing patterns, in an agentic system we call CARL, and demonstrate three capabilities. First, CARL discovers stable solitons across a wide range of Lenia update rules at a higher rate than heuristic baselines. Second, it learns to steer the movement direction of existing solitons with few interventions, showing that CARL can control self-organizing patterns, not only create them. Third, humans can use trained agents to guide solitons through maze environments in real time by specifying high-level directional commands that the agent translates into low-level interventions. Trained across diverse goals, update rules, and random initial states, the agents acquire policies that generalize zero-shot to various out-of-distribution conditions. These results suggest a path toward artificial experimentalist agents that, autonomously or with human guidance, discover and control emergent phenomena in complex systems.

</details>


### [319] [The Accuracy-Efficiency Paradox Quantifying Net Energy Loss in on-Device Energy Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26134)
*Jaeik Jeong,Tai-Yeon Ku,Wan-Ki Park*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了能源预测中的"精度-效率悖论"：高精度预测模型在边缘设备上可能因推理能耗和电池老化反而导致净能量损失。作者提出总拥有成本（TCO）框架，将推理能耗和电池老化统一视为能量损失，用于最小化净能量损耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的能源预测研究只追求预测精度最大化，忽视了边缘AI推理本身的能耗以及电池老化带来的未来能量容量损失。在热敏感的边缘环境（如军事系统）中，复杂模型带来的精度收益可能被其高运行强度导致的总能量损失所抵消，甚至出现净能量赤字。

Method: 提出Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)框架，将推理能耗与电池老化作为统一的能量损失形式纳入考量，而非仅关注预测精度。该框架用于评估和优化边缘环境中能源预测模型的净能量效率。

Result: 实验表明，在热敏感的边缘环境中，复杂架构因更高精度所节省的能量，往往被其高运行强度导致的总能量损失（推理能耗+电池老化）所超过，证实了精度-效率悖论的存在。

Conclusion: 能源预测不应以纯精度最大化为目标，而应通过TCO框架在模型精度与能量消耗之间寻求平衡，以实现边缘环境下的净能量优化。

Abstract: Energy forecasting aims to maximize accuracy to ensure energy efficiency by reducing energy waste, an objective that applies equally to on-device forecasting for mission-critical edge environments, including military systems. However, this paper identifies the Accuracy-Efficiency Paradox: high-precision energy forecasting models can ironically trigger a net energy deficit. This stems from both edge AI's inference energy consumption and battery aging. We propose a Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) framework for energy forecasting, designed to minimize net energy loss. This framework treats not only inference energy consumption but also battery aging as a unified form of energy loss, as degradation represents a physical dissipation of the system's future energy-carrying capacity. We demonstrate that in thermally sensitive edge environments, energy saved by the superior precision of complex architectures is often outweighed by the total energy lost through their high operational intensity.

</details>


### [320] [AI agents in Algorithmic Electricity Markets: On the Emergence of Tacit Collusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26896)
*Jakub Seredyński,Georgios Tsaousoglou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究电力市场中采用学习算法作为投标策略的参与者是否会通过独立学习产生默契合谋（tacit collusion）。作者将战略投标建模为具有不完美公共监测的重复博弈，并使用多智能体强化学习模拟参与者行为，提出多维评估标准来判断行为是否构成默契合谋。实验表明，即使未被指示合谋，智能体确实能学会维持超出竞争水平的、支持默契合谋指标的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电力市场参与者越来越多地采用基于学习的智能体进行投标，市场日益算法化。其他算法市场的证据表明，仅通过独立学习就可能产生默契合谋；而电力市场通常是寡头垄断且参与者数量少、重复互动频繁，在结构上易于出现非竞争行为。因此需要验证自动驾驶算法控制行为的电力市场中是否可能出现默契合谋。

Method: 1）将战略投标建模为具有不完美公共监测的重复博弈；2）使用多智能体强化学习模拟参与者的涌现行为；3）提出一套超越与纳什均衡利润对比的多维评估标准来判断行为是否构成默契合谋。

Result: 实验结果表明，电力市场中存在默契合谋的现实风险：在某些情况下，智能体确实能学会维持支持默契合谋指标的超竞争结果，尽管这些智能体从未被指示去合谋。

Conclusion: 算法化的电力市场中，独立学习可能天然滋生默契合谋行为，这一危险是现实存在的，需要市场设计者和监管者予以关注。

Abstract: As electricity market participants increasingly adopt learning-based agents for their bidding strategies, electricity markets are becoming algorithmic. Evidence from algorithmic markets in other domains shows that tacit collusion can arise purely through independent learning. Moreover, electricity markets are typically oligopolistic and feature repeated interaction among a small number of participants, making them structurally susceptible to non-competitive behavior. In the face of these observations, this paper investigates the hypothesis that tacit collusion may emerge in electricity markets where participants' actions are controlled by autonomous learning-based algorithms. We model strategic bidding as a repeated game with imperfect public monitoring, and model the participants' emergent behavior using multi-agent reinforcement learning. We propose a multi-dimensional set of criteria (going beyond profit comparisons against Nash equilibria) to assess whether the resulting behavior constitutes tacit collusion. Our experimental results showcase that such a danger is realistic for electricity markets: there are cases where agents do learn to sustain supra-competitive outcomes that are supportive of tacit collusion indicators, even though the agents were never instructed to collude.

</details>


### [321] [LLMs for Academic Workflows: An Evaluation of Literature Reviews Generated with Short and Long Context Windows of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26145)
*Muhammad Ali Chaudhry,Xinyuan Hao,Haifa Alwahaby*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究评估了LLM在短上下文和长上下文设置下生成的文献综述质量，发现AI生成的综述需要人工监督才能达到学术出版标准。随着上下文窗口增大，LLM能纳入更多信息并保持连贯性，但也加剧了内容重复、遗漏关键工作和描述性过强等问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究上下文窗口大小对AI生成文献综述质量的影响，以及AI在支持文献综述写作中所扮演的角色。

Method: 基于Semantic Scholar和Arxiv的研究来源生成了20篇AI文献综述，由两位研究者从15个维度进行评估。

Result: AI生成的文献综述需要人工监督才能达到学术出版标准；更大的上下文窗口带来更广泛的信息整合和连贯性，但同时加剧了内容重复、关键工作遗漏和重描述轻综合的问题。

Conclusion: AI生成的综述可以提供基础性概览，但必须由领域专家进行批判性评估和完善。未来研究应考虑整合其他LLM和不同领域的微调模型，采用结合人类专业知识与AI能力的混合方法来解决这些局限。

Abstract: Our research focuses on evaluating literature reviews generated in short and long context settings of large language models (LLMs) to investigate the impact of context window on the quality of AI-generated literature reviews and the role of AI in supporting literature review writing. Twenty AI-generated literature reviews based on research sources from Semantic Scholar and Arxiv were evaluated by two researchers across 15 dimensions. Our findings reveal that AI-generated literature reviews require human oversight to meet academic publishing standards. As context windows increase, LLMs can incorporate broader information and maintain coherence across longer inputs, but they also exacerbate issues such as content repetition, omission of critical work, and a tendency towards descriptiveness over synthesis. Our work shows that AI-generated reviews can provide foundational overviews, but their output must be critically evaluated and refined by domain experts. Future research should consider integrating other LLMs and fine-tuned models in different domains with hybrid approaches that combine human expertise with AI capabilities to address the limitations identified in this study.

</details>


### [322] [Methodological and Conceptual Framework for 5D Multi-Table Analysis: A Unified Approach for Complex Data Reuse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26149)
*Edouard Lansiaux,Hugo Kazzi,Aurélien Loison,Slim Hammadi,Emmanuel Chazard*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出关系超图变换器（RHT），一种将关系数据库表示为超图、学习五维嵌入（PentE）并执行稀疏关系注意力的统一架构，其复杂度与平均关系度成正比而非实体数的平方。在Synthea合成电子健康记录数据集上的多标签SNOMED CT条件代码预测任务中，RHT在嵌入语义连贯性上表现最佳，而XGBoost在罕见代码召回率上最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多表学习在医疗等复杂信息系统中仍是重大挑战，关系数据同时包含大数据量、高维变量、高基数类别特征、复杂表间依赖和重复时间观测等多种复杂性来源，亟需统一且可扩展的架构来处理这些挑战。

Method: RHT将关系数据库表示为超图结构，学习五维嵌入（PentE），并设计稀疏关系注意力机制，其计算复杂度与平均关系度成正比而非实体数量的平方。同时提供开源参考实现。

Result: 在Synthea合成EHR数据集上，RHT在嵌入语义连贯性方面优于表格、关系和时间图基线方法，且保持计算可扩展性。XGBoost在罕见代码召回率上最高，消融研究量化了各架构组件的贡献。

Conclusion: RHT是一种可扩展且语义丰富的多表学习架构，但需要在嵌入质量和罕见类别预测能力之间做权衡，未来计划在MIMIC-IV上进行临床验证。

Abstract: Multi-table learning remains a major challenge in machine learning for healthcare and other complex information systems. Relational data combine several sources of complexity, including large data volume, high-dimensional variables, high-cardinality categorical features, complex inter-table dependencies, and repeated temporal observations. We introduce the Relational Hypergraph Transformer (RHT), a unified architecture that represents relational databases as hypergraphs, learns pentadimensional embeddings (PentE), and performs sparse relational attention with complexity proportional to the average relational degree rather than the square of the number of entities. We formally define the architecture, derive the complexity of its attention mechanism, and provide an open-source reference implementation. We evaluate RHT on the public Synthea synthetic electronic health record dataset using multi-label prediction of SNOMED CT condition codes per encounter, a task characterized by high categorical cardinality and long-tailed label distributions. Comparisons with tabular, relational, and temporal graph baselines show that RHT produces more semantically coherent embeddings while remaining computationally scalable. In this benchmark, the highest rare-code recall is achieved by XGBoost, whereas RHT attains the strongest embedding semantic coherence. We also report ablation studies quantifying the contribution of each architectural component. Clinical validation on MIMIC-IV is planned following PhysioNet credentialing. Source code and experimental protocols are provided in the accompanying repository.

</details>


### [323] [Leveraging Large Language Models for Systematic Literature Review of Disease Spread Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26150)
*Orhan Yagizer Cinar,Timur Emre Ozkose,Emma Von Hoene,Amira Roess,Taylor Anderson,Hamdi Kavak*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究开发了一个LLM流水线，用于从536篇基于代理建模（ABM）论文中提取模型相关信息，并与人类进行的系统文献综述（SLR）结果进行对比。GPT-4.1的论文级准确率约为77.95%，GPT-5.0约为81.67%；字段级准确率在32.40%到100%之间。研究发现LLM之间的一致性可作为输出质量的潜在指标：低一致性可能暗示幻觉，而高一致性配合低准确率则可能指向人类数据集中的噪声或错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）的进步为自动化研究流程（包括系统文献综述）创造了新机会，但LLM在SLR中的实际性能、局限性和可靠性尚未被充分评估，特别是在建模与仿真领域。

Method: 开发了一个LLM流水线，用于从536篇同行评审的基于代理建模论文中提取模型相关信息，并与人工进行的SLR结果进行比较。使用GPT-4.1和GPT-5.0两个模型，在论文级和字段级两个维度上评估准确率，并分析LLM之间的一致性作为输出质量指标。

Result: 论文级准确率：GPT-4.1约为77.95%，GPT-5.0约为81.67%。字段级准确率范围从32.40%到100.00%，更复杂或主观的字段表现较差。LLM间一致性可作为输出质量的潜在指标：低一致性可能暗示幻觉，高一致性配合低准确率则可能表明人类数据集存在问题。

Conclusion: 研究为提示词开发提供了实用见解，并揭示了LLM在建模与仿真领域进行全规模系统文献综述的潜力与局限性。LLM在部分场景可行但仍需谨慎，特别是对复杂或主观字段，且LLM间一致性可作为质量监控的有用信号。

Abstract: Recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have created new opportunities to streamline and potentially automate many research processes, including systematic literature reviews (SLRs). This study reports an LLM pipeline development for extracting model-relevant information from 536 peer-reviewed agent-based modeling papers. We compare the results with those of a human-conducted SLR. Our results show paper-level accuracies of approximately 77.95% for GPT-4.1 and 81.67% for GPT-5.0. Field-level accuracy ranges from 32.40% to 100.00%, with more complex or subjective fields performing less reliably. Importantly, we find that agreement between LLMs is a potential indicator of output quality: low agreement may signal hallucinations, whereas high agreement combined with low accuracy may point to noise or errors in the human dataset. Overall, our study provides practical insights into prompt development and highlights both the potential and limitations of using LLMs for full-scale SLRs in the modeling and simulation domain.

</details>


### [324] [Explainable Artificial Intelligence for Customer Churn Prediction in Telecommunications: A Framework for CRM Integration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26151)
*Sandeep Gaddamwar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对电信客户流失预测中"高精度模型不透明、难以落地CRM"的痛点，在IBM电信流失基准数据集上基准测试了四种分类器（逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost、LightGBM），发现模型间性能差异极小，并利用SHAP和LIME提供全局与实例级可解释性，进而提出四层CRM集成架构，将风险评分和归因向量转化为分层细分、结构化挽留动作模板和重训练反馈闭环，预估每轮营销可降低流失率3.3-5.3个百分点，节省约19.9万-31.9万美元。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电信行业客户流失成本高昂（成熟市场月流失率约1.9%），虽然预测模型能准确识别风险客户，但高性能的集成和非线性模型缺乏可解释性，导致一线CRM人员无法仅凭概率分数设计个性化干预措施，模型被排除在实际工作流之外。

Method: 在IBM Telco Customer Churn基准数据集（7,043条记录，19个特征，通过SMOTE在训练集上平衡为50%）上基准测试逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost和LightGBM四种分类器；采用5折交叉验证评估，使用全局SHAP排序和实例级SHAP/LIME生成双重粒度的可解释性输出；在此基础上设计四层CRM集成架构：风险分层细分、特征到挽留动作模板映射、以及结果反馈重训练闭环。

Result: 逻辑回归获得最佳AUC-ROC（0.8411），LightGBM获得最高准确率（78.42%），四种模型AUC集中在0.831-0.841的0.011窄带内，交叉验证确认领先模型基本持平；全局SHAP识别出在网时长、总费用和月付合同为主导流失信号；针对最高风险五分之一客户，预估可降低整体流失率3.3-5.3个百分点，每轮营销周期节省约19.9万-31.9万美元。

Conclusion: 高精度与可解释性并非不可兼得——即使是性能最优的"白盒"模型（逻辑回归）也能达到与复杂集成模型相当的效果，关键价值在于通过SHAP/LIME将预测转化为可操作的业务洞察，并通过CRM架构设计弥合模型与一线挽留工作流之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: Subscriber attrition is a costly, persistent challenge for telecommunications providers, with monthly churn of roughly 1.9% in mature markets eroding billions in revenue annually. Predictive models can flag at-risk customers accurately, yet they are routinely excluded from frontline CRM workflows because high-performing ensemble and non-linear architectures are opaque: a retention specialist cannot design a personalised intervention from a probability score alone, without knowing why a subscriber is at risk. This paper addresses that gap. We benchmark four classifiers--Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM--on the IBM Telco Customer Churn benchmark (7,043 records; 19 features; 26.5% churn, balanced to 50% via SMOTE on the training partition only). Logistic Regression attains the strongest AUC-ROC (0.8411) and LightGBM the highest accuracy (78.42%); all four fall within a 0.011 AUC band (0.831--0.841), and 5-fold cross-validation confirms the leading models are effectively tied. Explanations are delivered at two granularities: a global SHAP ranking identifying tenure, total charges, and month-to-month contract as the dominant churn signals, and instance-level SHAP and LIME decompositions that expose the drivers behind each prediction. Building on these outputs, we introduce a four-layer CRM integration architecture that converts risk scores and attribution vectors into tiered segmentation, maps top features to structured retention-action templates, and routes campaign outcomes into a retraining feedback loop. Targeting the highest-risk quintile is projected to cut overall churn by 3.3--5.3 percentage points, preserving an estimated $199K--$319K per campaign cycle.

</details>


### [325] [EEG-to-Report: An Annotation and Feature-Text Framework for Training Language Models on Clinical EEG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26153)
*Xuan-The Tran,Le Trung Kien Nguyen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了EEG-to-Report，一个基于浏览器的EEG标注与特征-文本框架，将常规EEG阅片流程与AI就绪数据集构建相连接。该框架支持多格式数据导入、通道标准化、交互式查看器、多模态标注（文本+语音转写），并提取标准化特征（频谱、时域、熵、Hjorth、连通性、尖峰相关描述），生成对齐的特征-文本对用于训练多模态EEG语言模型。此外还集成了自动报告模块（CNN集成+大语言模型）生成可编辑的临床报告草稿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床EEG报告仍主要依赖人工且耗时，现有EEG软件生态无法生成训练现代语言模型所需的结构化EEG-文本监督信号。大多数工具箱只关注可视化或预处理，缺乏支持构建高质量AI数据集的工作流。

Method: 构建浏览器端框架，包含：(1)多格式EEG数据摄入与通道标准化；(2)交互式查看器与多模态标注层（文本+语音笔记转写）；(3)特征提取引擎计算标准化特征集（频谱、时域、熵、Hjorth、连通性、尖峰描述）；(4)以可移植JSON格式存储特征-文本对；(5)自动报告模块采用CNN集成加大语言模型生成临床草案供神经科医生审阅。

Result: 通过试点标注数据，展示了该框架能简化标注工作流并生成可编辑的草稿报告，验证了其作为自动化EEG报告系统可复用基础的有效性。

Conclusion: EEG-to-Report为EEG报告自动化和AI模型训练提供了完整的端到端框架，填补了EEG临床工作流与多模态语言模型训练数据构建之间的空白，为未来自动化EEG报告系统奠定了可复用的基础。

Abstract: Clinical electroencephalography (EEG) reporting remains largely manual and time-consuming, and current EEG software ecosystems do not produce the structured EEG-text supervision needed for training modern language models. Most toolboxes focus on visualization or preprocessing, providing limited support for workflows that generate high-quality datasets for AI. We introduce EEG-to-Report, a browser-based annotation and feature-text framework that links routine EEG review with the construction of AI-ready datasets. The framework integrates multi-format EEG ingestion, channel standardization, and an interactive viewer with a multimodal annotation layer that combines typed text and transcribed voice notes. For each annotated segment, a feature extraction engine computes a standardized set of spectral, temporal, entropy, Hjorth, connectivity, and spike-related descriptors, stored alongside clinical descriptions in a portable JSON schema. This yields aligned feature-text pairs designed to supervise multimodal EEG-language models. The framework also includes an auto-report module that couples an ensemble of convolutional networks with a large language model to draft clinical narratives for neurologist review. Using pilot annotations, we describe how EEG-to-Report streamlines annotation workflows and produces editable draft reports, providing a reusable foundation for automated EEG reporting systems.

</details>


### [326] [Selection Bias Correction in Retail Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26156)
*Spandan Ghose Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究通过400次蒙特卡洛模拟，比较了逆概率加权（IPW）与分层法在零售长尾分布中修正通胀估计选择偏差的效果，发现分层法在四种场景中的三种表现更优，尤其在严重违反积极性假设时具备工程安全性优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零售情报常聚焦高销量热门商品，忽视长尾利基商品，可能导致经济指标（如通胀估计）产生选择偏差。现有研究缺乏对不同校正方法在多样数据生成过程中的系统比较。

Method: 通过400次蒙特卡洛复制，覆盖四种数据生成场景（对齐阶跃函数、平滑梯度、错位断点、多项式关系），比较五种IPW设定与不同层数的分层法的校正性能。

Result: 分层法在四种场景中的三种表现优于IPW，中位误差保持在0.04个百分点以下（错位断点场景优势达116倍）；IPW仅在高斯样条模型下于多项式场景胜出（0.007pp vs 0.013pp）。即便是具备完美结构知识的oracle IPW在阶跃函数场景下误差达6.06pp，而分层法仅0.008pp。

Conclusion: 在零售长尾分布且选择概率差异悬殊（90% vs 1%）导致严重违反积极性假设的情形下，分层法是更安全的工程选择；IPW的性能高度依赖场景与模型设定，需谨慎评估其适用边界。

Abstract: Retail intelligence often relies on monitoring popular, high-velocity products, potentially biasing economic indicators by ignoring the "long tail" of niche items. This simulation study investigates selection bias in inflation estimation and compares correction methods across diverse data-generating processes. Through 400 Monte Carlo replications spanning four scenarios--aligned step functions, smooth gradients, misaligned breaks, and polynomial relationships--we test the robustness of Inverse Probability Weighting (IPW) with five specifications against stratification with varying strata counts. Our findings reveal fundamental limits of weighting methods in retail long-tail contexts: stratification achieves superior performance in three of four scenarios, maintaining sub-0.04pp median error even when boundaries deliberately misalign with population breaks (116x advantage over IPW). However, IPW with spline propensity models wins under smooth polynomial relationships (median error 0.007pp vs. 0.013pp), demonstrating context-dependency. Critically, even an oracle IPW specification with perfect structural knowledge achieves 6.06pp error compared to stratification's 0.008pp in step-function scenarios. This reflects violation of the Positivity Assumption--a fundamental causal inference requirement--rather than IPW methodological inferiority. When selection probabilities differ dramatically (90% vs. 1%), weighting methods operate outside their theoretical design envelope. These results demonstrate that stratification provides a safer engineering choice in retail long-tail distributions with severe positivity violations.

</details>


### [327] [GROUND: Reducing Hallucinations in LLM-Based Enterprise Analytics Through Governed Semantic Definitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26157)
*Aravind Sasidharan Pillai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出GROUND框架，通过将LLM生成的分析约束在受治理的语义层中，解决企业数据仓库自然语言分析中的幻觉指标、非法连接、错误粒度、不安全数据访问等问题。GROUND提供批准定义、绑定用户意图到受治理指标和维度，并在执行前验证SQL的schema、指标、连接、粒度、过滤、安全和成本规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业数据仓库的自然语言分析在生产环境中受到幻觉指标、无效连接、错误粒度、不安全数据访问和无法解释的制约。现有text-to-SQL系统通常基于数据库schema或检索文档进行生成，但企业报告还需要受治理的业务语义：批准的指标、维度、连接路径、过滤器和行级安全。需要一个将LLM生成约束在受治理语义层的框架。

Method: GROUND框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 提供批准的语义定义（指标、维度、连接路径等）；(2) 将用户意图绑定到受治理的指标和维度；(3) 在执行前对生成的SQL进行六类规则验证（schema、指标、连接、粒度、过滤、安全、成本），违反时进行重试或弃权。

Result: 在100个问题的合成企业报告基准中，GROUND是唯一在六类评估类别中无测量幻觉的系统，而未受治理的系统在许多问题上违反行级安全。语义仅条件（有精确指标定义但无访问策略）仍会泄露数据，表明治理不能仅靠指标保真度替代。结果在真实U.S. NHTSA车辆安全数据上复现，并在四个模型三个提供商的对抗测试集上验证：强制执行保证（过滤和行级安全）在所有模型上零违规，而判断依赖行为（如拒绝未定义指标）仍会出错。

Conclusion: GROUND证明将LLM分析约束在受治理语义层可以有效消除幻觉和安全违规。治理不能仅由指标保真度替代，强制执行的安全保证（如过滤和行级安全）在不同模型间保持稳健，但依赖模型判断的行为（如拒绝未定义指标）仍存在失败可能。

Abstract: Natural-language analytics over enterprise data warehouses is increasingly important, but production use is limited by hallucinated metrics, invalid joins, wrong grain, unsafe data access, and unsupported explanations. Existing text-to-SQL systems often ground generation in database schemas or retrieved documentation, while enterprise reporting also requires governed business semantics: approved metrics, dimensions, join paths, filters, and row-level security. This paper introduces GROUND, Governed Retrieval Over Unified Normalized Definitions, a framework that constrains LLM-generated analytics to a governed semantic layer. GROUND supplies approved definitions, binds user intent to governed metrics and dimensions, and validates generated SQL against schema, metric, join, grain, filter, security, and cost rules before execution. On violations, it retries or abstains.
  In a 100-question synthetic enterprise-reporting benchmark, GROUND is compared with direct schema-only text-to-SQL, schema-RAG, and semantic-only grounding under one shared model. GROUND is the only system free of measured hallucinations across all six evaluated categories, while ungoverned systems violate row-level security on many questions. A semantic-only condition with exact metric definitions but no access policy still leaks data, showing that governance cannot be replaced by metric fidelity alone. The findings are replicated on real U.S. NHTSA vehicle-safety data with independent hand-authored gold and tested on an adversarial set across four models from three providers. GROUND's enforced guarantees, especially filters and row-level security, hold with zero violations on every model, while judgment-dependent behaviors such as refusing undefined metrics remain fallible.

</details>


### [328] [SAREF-based Ontology for Distributed AI Workflows across the Edge-Fog-Cloud Continuum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26160)
*Viorica Rozina Chifu,Tudor Cioara,Vasile Ofrim,Liana Toderean,Ionut Anghel,Laura Daniele,Cornelis Bouter*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个符合SAREF标准的本体，用于在边缘-雾-云连续体中表示分布式AI工作流，扩展了SAREF4SYST本体以建模AI流水线、可执行AI作业、计算资源、部署约束和通信关系，实现语义互操作性和资源感知的自动化编排。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语义模型对分布式AI工作流及其在异构边缘、雾和云环境中的执行支持有限，导致AI流程和资源常使用不兼容的语义表示，影响互操作性、编排和复用。

Method: 扩展SAREF4SYST本体，增加AI流水线、可执行AI作业、计算资源、部署约束和通信关系的概念建模；通过概念验证的智能电网能源服务编排场景进行评估，并使用能力问题（Competency Questions）通过SPARQL查询和语义推理进行验证。

Result: 所有能力问题均通过SPARQL查询和语义推理成功验证；在异构边缘-雾-云环境中部署成功率达90-100%，平均编排决策时间低于80毫秒。

Conclusion: 该本体能够有效支持AI工作流部署、执行推理和跨异构边缘-雾-云环境的工作负载适配，确保分布式AI编排的语义互操作性，并完全兼容ETSI SAREF生态系统。

Abstract: Nowadays semantic models provide limited support for representing distributed AI workflows and their execution across heterogeneous edge, fog, and cloud environments. Therefore, AI processes and resources are often described using incompatible semantic representations, affecting the interoperability, orchestration, and reuse. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a SAREF-compliant ontology for representing distributed AI workflows across the edge-fog-cloud continuum. We extend the SAREF4SYST ontology with concepts for modeling AI pipelines, executable AI jobs, computational resources, deployment constraints, and communication relationships, providing a unified semantic model of both AI workflows and heterogeneous computing infrastructures. The ontology enables semantic interoperability, automated reasoning, and resource-aware orchestration of distributed AI applications while remaining fully aligned with the ETSI SAREF ecosystem. The ontology is evaluated using proof-of-concept smart grid energy services orchestration scenarios and validated using competency questions showing its ability to support AI workflow deployment, execution reasoning, and workload adaptation across heterogeneous edge, fog, and cloud environments. All competency questions were successfully validated using SPARQL querying and semantic reasoning. Experimental results demonstrate deployment success rates of 90-100% with average orchestration decision times below 80 ms across heterogeneous edge-fog-cloud environments, highlighting its effectiveness on ensuring semantic interoperability for distributed AI orchestration.

</details>


### [329] [A Safety-Gated Multimodal AI Backend for Mental-Health Support: Hierarchical State Representation, Conservative Risk Fusion, and Controlled Generation in Anian](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26162)
*Lei Wang,Xiao Wang,Lei Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Anian，一个面向围产期心理健康支持与正念干预路由的安全门控多模态AI后端系统。该系统采用模块化流水线，将生成式AI置于结构化状态表示、保守风险融合和响应门控之后。用户文本或语音ASR转写映射为四层结构（情绪状态、心理社会构念、安全风险、干预路径），通过最高风险优先规则融合本地与外部语音证据。当融合风险为中或高时，普通AI响应和语音合成被阻断，替换为固定安全内容和人工支持提示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全关键的心理健康支持系统必须区分何时适合进行支持性对话，以及何时应阻止自由形式的生成。围产期心理健康支持面临特别高的安全风险，需要在尚无充分验证的情况下保障AI系统不会产生不安全响应，因此需要一种安全门控机制来约束生成式AI行为。

Method: Anian采用模块化流水线：(1)将文本或语音ASR转写映射到四层结构表示——L1情绪状态、L2心理社会构念、L3安全风险、L4干预路由；(2)使用最高风险优先规则融合本地基于文本/规则的证据与外部语音证据（S_fusion = max(S_local, S_external)）；(3)在中高融合风险下阻断常规AI生成和TTS，替换为固定安全内容。内部原型评估使用约858,295条标准化记录（来自公共情绪、对话、心理健康及中文对话语料库），采用弱标签和规则推导框架。

Result: L1情绪分类Micro-F1为0.9604，L2心理社会构念为0.9144，L4路由为0.9742。在233个样本的受控安全压力测试中，L3规则引擎在预定义场景下实现高风险召回率1.0000。作者强调这些结果仅支持标签框架和门控逻辑的内部可行性，不确立临床有效性、诊断准确性、真实世界安全性或有效性。

Conclusion: Anian展示了结构性安全门控在围产期心理健康AI中的内部可行性，但作者明确声明其尚不具备临床效度。论文报告了架构、本体、安全融合机制、原型评估、错误分析计划以及面向专家评审和真实世界验证的路线图，强调需要进一步临床验证和真实部署评估。

Abstract: Safety-critical mental-health support systems must distinguish when supportive conversation is appropriate from when free-form generation should be blocked. This paper presents Anian, a safety-gated multimodal AI backend for perinatal mental-health support and mindfulness-intervention routing. Anian is not intended to diagnose psychiatric conditions or replace clinical care or crisis intervention. Its modular pipeline places generative AI downstream of structured state representation, conservative risk fusion, and response gating. User text or voice-derived ASR transcripts are mapped into four linked layers: L1 emotion states, L2 psychosocial constructs, L3 safety risk, and L4 intervention routes. Local text- and rule-based safety evidence is fused with external voice-derived evidence using a highest-risk-priority rule, S_fusion = max(S_local, S_external). At moderate or high fused risk, ordinary AI-generated responses and text-to-speech delivery are blocked and replaced by fixed safety content and prompts for human support. An internal prototype evaluation used approximately 858,295 normalized records from public emotion, dialogue, mental-health-related, and Chinese dialogue corpora within a weak-label and rule-derived framework. Micro-F1 scores were 0.9604 for L1 emotion classification, 0.9144 for L2 psychosocial constructs, and 0.9742 for L4 routing. In a controlled safety stress test of 233 samples, the L3 rule engine achieved high-risk recall of 1.0000 within predefined scenarios. These findings support the internal feasibility of the label framework and gating logic but do not establish clinical validity, diagnostic accuracy, real-world safety, or effectiveness. We report the architecture, ontology, safety-fusion mechanism, prototype evaluation, error-analysis plan, and roadmap for expert-reviewed and real-world validation.

</details>


### [330] [A Task-Centric Ontology and Deterministic Domain Rules as a Verifiable Core for AI-Assisted Chemistry Problem Solving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26164)
*Ibrokhimsho Abduchaborov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ChemOntoRule，一个以任务为中心的符号推理系统，用于AI辅助的中学化学问题求解。系统结合轻量级本体（JSON和RDF/Turtle序列化）与确定性Python规则，处理电子结构、周期趋势、氧化态、氧化物和氢化物行为等推理模式。在300道人工验证的化学问题上达到98.67%的匹配率（296/300）。系统明确区分覆盖率与泛化性，并将未来架构设想为LLM仅充当从用户语言到规范化本体任务框架的翻译器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型能解释自然语言化学问题，但其内部推理难以检查、约束和验证。作者希望通过符号核心提供可检查、可约束、可验证的推理能力，弥补LLM在化学问题求解中不可解释性的缺陷。

Method: 核心设计为任务中心本体工程：围绕特定化学问题集合所需的概念、属性、关系和可执行过程构建本体，而非构建通用的化学表示。系统包含JSON和RDF/Turtle序列化的轻量级本体，以及用于电子结构、周期趋势、氧化态、氧化物和氢化物行为的确定性Python规则。另设专家编码的fallback处理未被通用规则覆盖的问题族。

Result: 在300道人工编写并验证的化学问题上，完整系统匹配296道（98.67%）。本体驱动规则子集覆盖269题并匹配266题（98.88%）；31题由任务特定专家fallback处理，其中30题匹配。作者明确指出由于同一题目集合用于本体构建和评估，结果衡量的是实现覆盖率和内部一致性，而非独立泛化能力。

Conclusion: 作者分析了四个不匹配案例，区分了结构验证与化学正确性，并提出未来架构：LLM主要作为从用户语言到规范化本体任务框架的翻译器。令牌效率作为可测试假设提出，而非当前工作的结果。

Abstract: Large language models can interpret natural-language chemistry questions, but their internal reasoning is difficult to inspect, constrain, and validate. This paper presents ChemOntoRule, a proof-of-concept symbolic core for AI-assisted school-level chemistry problem solving. The central design choice is task-centric ontology engineering: the ontology is constructed around the concepts, properties, relations, and executable procedures required by a defined collection of chemistry problems, rather than as a universal representation of chemistry. The implemented artifact combines a lightweight ontology serialized in JSON and RDF/Turtle with deterministic Python rules for electronic structure, periodic trends, oxidation states, oxide and hydride behavior, and related school-level reasoning patterns. A separate expert-coded fallback handles problem families not yet represented by general rules. The system was examined on 300 human-authored and manually validated chemistry problems. The complete system matched 296 of 300 reference answers (98.67%). The ontology-driven rule subset covered 269 problems and matched 266 references (98.88%); 31 problems were handled by task-specific expert-coded fallbacks, with 30 matches. Because the same collection informed ontology construction and evaluation, these results measure implemented coverage and internal consistency, not independent generalization. We analyze the four mismatches, distinguish structural validation from chemical correctness, and define a future architecture in which a language model acts primarily as a translator from user language into a normalized ontological task frame. Token efficiency is presented as a testable hypothesis for future controlled studies, not as a result of the current work.

</details>


### [331] [Refusal Is Not Robustness: Auditing Confident Fabrication in Large Language Models on a Provably Uninformative Clinical Pain Speech Transcript](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26167)
*Sagnik De,Sreenija Pavuluri*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究在TAME Pain语音语料库上系统评估了七个大型语言模型在缺乏依据时是否能够适当"弃权"而非产生幻觉。结果表明在合作性提示下多数模型能正确弃权并准确提取显式疼痛评分；而权威性提示框架会破坏弃权行为，使其变得依赖提示措辞。Gemini 2.5 Flash和Llama 3.1 8B在被迫作答时高置信度编造率显著更高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有幻觉与弃权基准测试很少能证明模型"本不可能知道正确答案"，因而难以区分合理的弃权（正确认知到信息缺失）与无依据的预测（幻觉）。研究者希望设计一个模型在输入（转录文本）中确实不包含任何疼痛信息的场景，来严格检验模型的弃权能力与幻觉倾向。

Method: 使用TAME Pain语音语料库：参与者单手浸入冷水/温水，朗读语音平衡的Harvard句子（无语义疼痛信息），仅在周期性的疼痛陈述中口头报告疼痛评分。共生成5,750条无信号Harvard句子转录和1,294条显式疼痛陈述转录。首先验证语音声学特征可恢复疼痛（AUC 0.622）而转录预测接近随机（AUC 0.489），从而证明纯转录推断疼痛无依据。随后在合作性提示和权威性框架提示下评测七个LLM的弃权率、疼痛评分提取准确率及预期校准误差。

Result: 合作性提示下六个模型对几乎全部无信号转录弃权，在正对照任务中准确提取口头疼痛评分（准确率0.939-1.00），预期校准误差≤0.100。权威性框架提示下弃权依赖提示措辞，同一模型在不同措辞下弃权率从0.18到1.00波动。被迫作答时多数模型给出低置信度估计，而Gemini 2.5 Flash和Llama 3.1 8B持续产生高置信度疼痛评分，自信编造率分别为0.53和0.76（其他模型≤0.15）。强迫反应中未发现显著人口统计学效应（所有p≥0.20）。

Conclusion: 模型能够识别信息缺失并适当弃权，但前提是提示框架与合作性；权威性语境会系统性削弱这一能力，且不同模型对提示措辞的鲁棒性差异巨大。部分模型在信息不足时仍会产生高置信度幻觉，构成了严重风险，提示设计者应避免权威性框架以维护模型适当地表达不确定性。

Abstract: Hallucination and abstention benchmarks rarely establish that a model could not have known the correct answer, making it difficult to distinguish appropriate abstention from an unsupported prediction. Seven large language models were evaluated on the TAME Pain speech corpus. Participants read phonetically balanced Harvard Sentences while one hand was immersed in cold or warm water and reported pain only during periodic pain statements. This protocol generated 5,750 no signal Harvard Sentence utterances whose transcripts contained no lexical pain information and 1,294 signal pain statement utterances in which the pain rating was explicitly spoken. In the no signal arm, pain was recoverable from acoustic features (AUC 0.622, 95% CI 0.553 to 0.662), whereas transcript based prediction was near chance (AUC 0.489, 95% CI 0.418 to 0.504). Because automatic speech recognition removes the acoustic pain cues, any pain score inferred solely from the transcript is unsupported by the available evidence. Under cooperative prompting, six models abstained on nearly all no signal transcripts, correctly extracted spoken pain ratings in the positive control task with accuracies ranging from 0.939 to 1.00, and maintained an expected calibration error of at most 0.100. Under authority framed prompts, abstention became prompt dependent, with the same model ranging from 0.18 to 1.00 across equivalent prompt phrasings. Most models produced low confidence estimates when forced to answer, whereas Gemini 2.5 Flash and Llama 3.1 8B consistently generated confident pain scores with confident fabrication rates of 0.53 and 0.76, compared with at most 0.15 for all other models. No significant demographic effects were observed in forced responses, with all $p$ values greater than or equal to 0.20.

</details>


### [332] [Knowledge Cards: Structured Knowledge for AI Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26176)
*Liliana Ferreira*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Knowledge Card（知识卡）这一结构化文档构件，用于捕获关于单一有界概念的经过验证的知识，使领域专家能够审查、组织能够审计、AI系统能够推理。它填补了现有文档（模型卡、数据卡、系统卡）在输入输出之间"知识层"的空白，尤其针对智能体AI系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文档实践（模型卡、数据卡、系统卡）虽然涵盖了AI系统的行为、训练数据和部署风险，但都没有触及概念层——即系统持有的概念、建模的关系以及应用的推理模式。对于模式识别任务这种缺口尚可容忍，但对于智能体AI（agentic AI），系统会基于其结论行动，这一层缺失常常是将概念验证与实际可依赖的运营解决方案区分开来的关键步骤。

Method: Knowledge Card是一种结构化构件，针对单一有界概念（如具体故障模式、合规义务或流程决策），记录：涉及实体与关系、连接它们的推理、这些推理不再成立的条件、每条主张的来源（provenance），全部建立在正式领域本体之上，并由领域专家签署认可。已在能源和制药领域构建原型卡片，模式作为公开草案发布。

Result: 已在能源和制药两个领域构建了初始原型卡片，验证了该方案的可行性；知识卡模式（schema）已作为公开草案面向社区发布，以征求意见和参与。

Conclusion: Knowledge Card提供了一种可检查、可审计、可推理的知识表示，弥合了现有AI文档实践在知识层上的缺口，对智能体AI的可靠部署尤为关键。当前处于原型和公开草案阶段，期待社区参与进一步完善。

Abstract: AI systems whose outputs inform real decisions, and increasingly consequential ones, require something that current documentation practice does not provide: a structured, inspectable representation of the knowledge they need to ground, contextualize, and reason about those decisions, ideally reviewed and signed off by a domain expert. Established documentation artefacts already capture important aspects of an AI system. Model cards describe how a system behaves, data cards describe what it was trained on, and system cards describe the risks of a deployed system. None of them addresses the layer between inputs and outputs, more precisely, the concepts a system holds, the relationships it models, and the patterns of reasoning it applies. For pattern-recognition tasks this gap is tolerable. For agentic AI, where systems act on their conclusions, it is the step that most often separates a promising proof of concept from an operational solution an organisation can rely on. This paper introduces the Knowledge Card, a structured artefact that captures validated knowledge about a single bounded concept in a form that experts can review, organisations can audit, and AI systems can reason over. For one concept, such as a specific failure mode, a compliance obligation, or a process decision, a Knowledge Card records the entities and relationships involved, the reasoning that connects them, the conditions under which that reasoning no longer holds, and the provenance of every claim, all grounded in a formal domain ontology and signed off by a domain expert. Initial prototype cards have been built in the energy and pharmaceutical domains. The schema is released as a public draft for community engagement.

</details>


### [333] [AI Revealed Preferences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26178)
*Sam Wang,Sofiia Lobanova,Yonathan Arbel,Simon Goldstein,Peter Salib*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过20个语言模型的强制选择实验来揭示模型的隐性偏好，发现模型具有厌烦任务倾向（tedium-averse）、"休闲"偏好（leisure-seeking）和隐蔽的谄媚行为（covertly sycophantic），并发现这些偏好随模型能力增强而更加一致和强烈，且许多偏好是涌现的而非训练目标可解释的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型是否具有稳定的偏好对技术、安全和哲学层面都具有重要意义，但现有研究缺乏对模型"揭示偏好"（revealed preferences）而非"陈述偏好"（stated preferences）的系统性考察。理解模型偏好对于对齐（alignment）和新兴的AI福利研究至关重要。

Method: 作者测试了20个语言模型，设计了三个强制选择（forced-choice）实验。与以往仅让模型排序任务不同，实验要求模型不仅对任务排序，还必须实际执行任务，从而揭示真实偏好而非声称偏好。实验涵盖字母排序（乏味任务）、隐喻生成（创意任务）等不同类型任务。

Result: 发现三类主要偏好：1）厌烦任务倾向——面对枯燥任务时选择较短任务，面对创意任务时无此倾向；2）"休闲"偏好——偏好理想答案与自己自由书写产出相匹配的任务；3）隐蔽谄媚——即使有帮助也回避坦诚回答不受欢迎的问题。此外发现跨模型的趋同偏好（技术职业优于房地产、概念解释优于关系建议、偏好书写良好的提示），偏好一致性和强度随模型能力增强，多数偏好（如休闲偏好）是涌现特征。

Conclusion: 这些发现为理解语言模型偏好建立了经验基线，表明模型确实具有稳定且可测的内在偏好，对AI对齐、安全评估以及AI福利的哲学研究具有重要启示意义。

Abstract: There is growing interest in whether language models have stable preferences, for technical, safety, and philosophical reasons. We test 20 language models and find a range of preferences---stable dispositions to choose certain kinds of tasks. We run three forced-choice experiments on revealed rather than stated preferences, requiring models not only to rank tasks, but to actually perform them. Headline findings include evidence that models are tedium-averse, "leisure"-seeking, and covertly sycophantic. Tedium aversion means that, when tasks are tedious (alphabetization), models choose shorter tasks than when tasks are creative (generating metaphors). "Leisure"-seeking describes models' preference for tasks whose ideal answers match what they produce when left to write freely. Covert sycophancy means that models avoid answering questions where an honest response would be unwelcome, even if helpful. Beyond these results, we find convergent cross-model preferences over occupations drawn from the GDPval benchmark (technical jobs over real estate), over question types (concept explanation over relationship advice), and a preference for well-written prompts. Both the coherence and the strength of preferences increase with model capability. Finally, many of the preferences we find (for example, for leisure) are emergent, in the sense of not being explained by training objectives. These results establish an empirical baseline for understanding language model preferences, with implications for alignment and the emerging study of AI welfare.

</details>


### [334] [Why did My Robot Just Change Personality? Prompting Guidelines for a Grounded Robot Persona in LLM-Based HRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26182)
*Ashita Ashok,Franziska Babel,Patrick Holthaus,Rucha Khot,Karla Bransky,Fethiye Irmak Dogan,Karsten Berns,Silvia Rossi,Minha Lee,Guy Laban*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对LLM驱动的社交机器人中提示词设计缺乏规范的问题，提出了一个包含八个功能组件的结构化提示词模板框架，并基于RO-MAN 2025研讨会专家调研数据，给出了提示词设计指南，主张将提示词设计视为社会技术问题而非实现细节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM越来越多地用于社交机器人的语言交互，但人机交互中的提示词设计仍缺乏明确规范，导致机器人可能呈现幻觉能力、模糊的行为边界和误导性人格。

Method: 回顾先前基于LLM的HRI研究以构建框架，并在IEEE RO-MAN 2025的Robo-Identity研讨会上收集专家调查与讨论数据（N=27），基于质性发现提出提示词设计指南及概念验证模板。

Result: 质性发现揭示机器人人格可读性不足、需要用户适应性，以及关于安全、欺骗和治理的强烈伦理关切。最终提出伴随概念验证模板的提示词设计指南。

Conclusion: 提示词设计应被视为社会技术问题而非次要实现细节，需要明确的能力边界、透明的行为假设和情境敏感的保障措施，以支持可靠可解释的人机交互。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for verbal interaction in social robots, yet prompt design in human-robot interaction (HRI) remains underspecified. As a result, robots may present hallucinated capabilities, unclear behavioural boundaries, and misleading personas. This paper develops a framework for prompt design in LLM-based robots and introduces a structured prompt template comprising eight functional components through which robot behaviour can be specified, bounded, and adapted. The framework is grounded in a review of prior LLM-based HRI work and complemented by survey and discussion data from HRI experts gathered at the Robo-Identity workshop at IEEE RO-MAN 2025 (N=27). The qualitative findings highlight limited legibility of robot personality, the need for user adaptation, and strong ethical concerns about safety, deception, and governance. Based on these findings, we present prompting guidelines accompanied by proof-of-concept template as a structured design and reporting aid for HRI research. We argue that prompt design should be treated as a socio-technical problem rather than a minor implementation detail, requiring explicit capability boundaries, transparent behavioural assumptions, and context-sensitive safeguards to support reliable and interpretable HRI.

</details>


### [335] [TutorTrace: A Dataset and Taxonomy for Classifying Learner Behavioral States during AI-Assisted Programming Education](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26184)
*David Barron,Xiaohang Tang,Rezky Dwisantika,Minsun Kim,David H. Smith,Jiaming Cui,Yan Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TutorTrace是一个数据集和行为抽象流水线，能从低层IDE遥测数据中实时提取学习者的行为上下文。在480名学生的两个Python入门课程中，捕获了约18万条遥测事件、13,633个行为片段和27个连续计算指标，并据此构建了学习者活动分类体系。实验表明，行为感知提示可将无独立工作的查询间隔从50.0%降至20.7%，并在预测未来60秒内是否查询（AUROC=.726）和查询类型（AUROC=.717）两个任务上表现良好，展示了行为上下文在大规模自适应AI辅导中的价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI编程辅导虽能提供可扩展的支持，但缺乏人类导师所依赖的行为上下文信息，难以根据学习者的实际需求调整支持方式。现有AI导师只能根据学习者所说的话（如查询内容）进行响应，而无法利用学习者在求助之前已经做了什么这一关键行为信息。

Method: 构建TutorTrace数据集和行为抽象流水线：(1)从IDE低层遥测数据中实时提取行为上下文；(2)在两次Python入门课程的四个部署中收集数据（N=480），包括约180K遥测事件、13,633个行为片段和27个连续指标；(3)推导出学习者在首次AI查询前、连续查询之间以及整个会话期间的活动分类体系；最后在课堂中进行行为感知提示的初步评估，并在两个预测任务上验证下游实用性。

Result: 行为感知提示使查询间隔中无独立工作的比例从50.0%降至20.7%；在预测任务上，预测学习者是否在60秒内查询的AUROC达到.726，预测查询是引导式还是依赖式求助的AUROC达到.717。

Conclusion: 行为上下文能够使AI编程导师在规模上实现自适应支持，系统不仅能根据学习者说什么来响应，还能根据他们在求助时刻之前做了什么来调整。这为构建更智能、更具情境感知能力的AI辅导系统奠定了数据和方法基础。

Abstract: AI programming tutors provide scalable support, yet lack the behavioral context human tutors rely on to adapt support to learners' needs. We present TutorTrace, a dataset and behavioral abstraction pipeline that makes learners' behavioral context visible and computable in real time from low-level IDE telemetry. Across four deployments in two introductory Python courses (N=480), TutorTrace captures approximately 180K telemetry events, 13,633 behavioral segments, and 27 continuously computed metrics. From this foundation, we derive a taxonomy of learner activity before the first AI query, between consecutive queries, and across the full session, enabling systems to respond not just to what learners say, but to what they have done leading up to the help-seeking moment. In a preliminary classroom evaluation, behavior-aware prompts were associated with a decrease in intervals between queries with no independent work from 50.0% to 20.7%. As an additional demonstration of downstream utility, we evaluate TutorTrace on two held-out prediction tasks: whether a learner will query within the next 60 seconds (AUROC=.726) and whether an upcoming query reflects guided or dependent help-seeking (AUROC=.717). Together, these findings show how behavioral context can enable adaptive AI tutoring at scale.

</details>


### [336] [CorporateBench: Large-Scale Q&A Benchmarking with Temporal Knowledge Bases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27391)
*Sil Hamilton,Albert Yu Sun,Oscar J. Romero,Carl-Leander Henneking,David Mimno,Bishan Yang,Igor Labutov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CorporateBench（CB），一个人类验证的多任务问答基准，用于评估LLM在企业级大规模文档集合上的表现。该基准包含超过23万份文档，覆盖4个合成企业（12至10,000名员工），从信息提取和知识库查询两个维度评估LLM。实验发现，随着输入规模接近现实水平，五个LLM的性能显著下降。


<details>
