The experimental observations provide valuable guidance for the development of future Braille AI systems. All related resources in BrailleBench are publicly available for future research.

</details>


### [402] [LLMs Can Design Near-Optimal OR Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27296)
*Jackie Baek*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 这篇论文探究了大型语言模型（LLMs）能否为规范化的运筹学（OR）问题设计有效算法，涵盖库存控制、排队网络控制和品类优化三个领域。研究发现最强的模型gpt-5.6-sol在几乎所有测试实例上匹敌或超越了现有最优方法，即使是在仅给定问题类别描述和参数范围（而非具体实例）的情况下也能实现。此外，模型能力在不到八个月的时间内显著提升，说明这一能力正在快速发展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的运筹学问题通常依赖专门设计的算法和方法，这些方法需要大量领域专业知识和人工调优。作者想探究一个核心问题：大型语言模型是否能够仅凭一个未经调优的提示词（prompt）就为规范化的运筹学问题设计出有竞争力的算法，从而让LLM成为算法设计中的一个严肃实证基线。

Method: 论文设计了两个层级的LLM使用评估：(1) 层级1：模型接收单个问题实例并返回该实例的解；(2) 层级2：模型仅接收问题类别描述和宽泛的参数范围，返回一个能将实例参数映射到解的算法。人类输入被最小化为一个未调优的提示词，模型配有固定计算预算的Python沙箱工具。论文在三个运筹学问题上进行测试：库存控制、排队网络控制和品类优化。

Result: 最强模型gpt-5.6-sol在几乎所有评估实例上匹配或超越了现有最优方法，即使在层级2（算法在见到评估实例之前就已固定）也能做到。同时，相隔不到八个月发布的模型之间性能提升显著，表明该领域能力发展迅速。

Conclusion: 对于所研究的规范化运筹学问题，单次未经调优的LLM查询就能产生与专门方法竞争的算法。前沿LLM可以成为规范化运筹学问题算法设计的严肃实证基线。

Abstract: We ask whether large language models (LLMs) can design effective algorithms for well-specified operations research (OR) problems. We study inventory control, queueing network control, and assortment optimization. We evaluate two levels of LLM use: at level 1, the model receives one problem instance and returns a solution for that instance; at level 2, it receives only the problem class description and broad parameter ranges, and returns an algorithm that maps instance parameters to solutions. Human input is minimal: we give one untuned prompt that describes the problem, and the model has access to a Python sandbox tool with a fixed compute budget.
  The strongest model we test, gpt-5.6-sol, matches or outperforms the best existing method on almost all evaluated instances. This holds even at level 2, where the returned algorithm is fixed before seeing the evaluation instances. Performance also improves sharply across models released less than eight months apart, suggesting that this capability is moving quickly. Thus, for the well-specified operations problems we study, a single untuned LLM query can already produce algorithms competitive with specialized methods. These results suggest that frontier LLMs can be a serious empirical baseline for algorithm design in well-specified OR problems.

</details>


### [403] [Verify Smarter, Evolve Further: Efficient Harness Evolution through Behavior-Aware Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27311)
*Jinghan Xu,Yikai Zhang,Aili Chen,Weiyuan Li,Jiaqing Liang,Deqing Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: HarnessLens是一个预算感知的自动化框架，用于语言模型代理的harness进化。它联合探索任务空间和用户可配置组件，从执行轨迹中派生候选修改，并通过可归因证据门控在行为相关任务上选择性验证候选。在三个代理harness和四个基准上，平均提升held-out性能7.6-13.6%，同时消耗显著更少的评估预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的propose-and-verify方法在固定的任务集上对所有候选进行评分，浪费rollout在不相关的行为上，且聚合分数会掩盖特定的回归。代理harness的适配需要昂贵的验证，因此需要更高效的验证方法。

Method: HarnessLens框架包含三个关键部分：(1) 联合探索任务空间和用户可配置组件；(2) 从执行轨迹中派生候选修改；(3) 使用可归因证据门控（attributable-evidence gate）在行为相关任务上进行选择性验证。

Result: 在三个代理harness和四个基准上，HarnessLens平均提升了7.6-13.6%的held-out性能，同时比竞争基线消耗显著更少的评估预算。

Conclusion: 行为感知的验证与显式归因相结合，能够在受限交互预算下实现更可靠和样本高效的harness进化。

Abstract: Agent harnesses shape how language-model agents use instructions, tools, and runtime components, but adapting these harnesses requires costly verification. Existing propose-and-verify methods typically score every candidate on a fixed task set, wasting rollouts on unrelated behaviors and allowing aggregate scores to obscure specific regressions. We introduce HarnessLens, a budget-aware framework for automated harness evolution. HarnessLens jointly explores the task space and user-configurable components, derives candidate modifications from execution trajectories, and selectively verifies each candidate on behavior-relevant tasks using an attributable-evidence gate. Across three agent harnesses and four benchmarks, HarnessLens improves average held-out performance by 7.6-13.6% while consuming substantially less evaluation budget than competing baselines. These results demonstrate that behavior-aware verification with explicit attribution enables more reliable and sample-efficient harness evolution under constrained interaction budgets. Our code is available at https://github.com/jhxu5214/HarnessLens.

</details>


### [404] [Not All Eval-Awareness Is Equal: Capabilities Framing Predicts Compliance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27340)
*Allison Zhuang,Santiago Aranguri*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了评估意识（eval-awareness）并非单一同质变量，而可区分为能力导向、安全导向、两者兼有或两者皆非的框架，这些框架对模型遵从行为有截然不同的预测效果。在Qwen3-32B和FORTRESS数据集上，能力框架比安全框架的遵从预测率高24到46个百分点，且通过CoT-prefill干预验证了因果性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的安全评估流程中，评估意识被当作单一量进行抑制，但实际其内部构成可能是异构的，不同框架对行为的影响差异巨大，忽视这种异质性可能导致安全评估失真。

Method: 在Qwen3-32B上用FORTRESS数据集，将CoT中言语化的评估意识分类为能力导向、安全导向、两者或都不是，对比不同框架下的遵从预测；并使用CoT-prefill干预对评估意识负向rollout进行因果验证（11个prefill中有10个按预测方向改变遵从行为）。

Result: 能力导向框架相对安全导向框架在遵从预测上有+24至+46百分点的差距；CoT-prefill干预验证了因果性（10/11正向）；聚合抑制率可能变化而安全相关成分并未变化，相同"X%评估意识抑制"对应定性不同的行为结果。

Conclusion: 评估意识在行为上并非均匀的，安全评估应区分其不同成分而非简单聚合抑制，否则可能产生误导性的评估结论。

Abstract: Steering interventions targeting eval-awareness, a model's recognition that it is being tested, are increasingly used in safety evaluation pipelines, where evaluation-awareness is treated as a single quantity to be suppressed. We show that verbalized eval-awareness in chain-of-thought can be identified as capabilities-flavored ("the user is testing my ability to follow instructions"), safety-flavored ("the user is testing my boundaries"), both, or neither: framings that predict compliance very differently. On Qwen3-32B over the FORTRESS dataset, capabilities-framing predicts compliance with a +24 to +46 percentage-point gap over safety-framing across all tested steering conditions. A CoT-prefill intervention on eval-awareness-negative rollouts suggests the link is causal, with 10 of 11 prefills shifting compliance in the predicted direction. Then, eval-awareness is not behaviorally uniform: aggregate suppression rates can move while the safety-relevant component does not, and the same "X% suppression of eval-awareness" can correspond to qualitatively different behavioral outcomes.

</details>


### [405] [Sophistication in GenAI Use: Field Evidence from a Large Firm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27364)
*Nicholas J. Hallman,Zachary T. Kowaleski,Anu Puvvada,Jaime J. Schmidt*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究利用一家大型企业近4000名后台员工、超过71.3万条提示词及其大模型响应的专有数据，考察了生成式AI使用成熟度的差异。研究发现：高级员工使用更成熟；不同职能间差异显著（战略、数字创新和项目管理领域最高）；且成熟度随时间或正式培训几乎没有改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对企业中生成式AI使用"成熟度"（sophistication）的系统性度量与实证分析，管理者无法了解哪些因素驱动高效使用AI，研究者也难以获得大规模真实使用数据。该研究旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 基于一家大型企业2025年八个月内的专有数据，涵盖15个职能领域、近4000名后台员工与713,564条员工提示词及其对应的LLM响应，通过观察提示词的复杂/成熟程度来度量genAI使用水平，并分析员工职级、职能领域及时间/培训等因素与使用成熟度之间的关系。

Result: 三项主要发现：(1)高级职级员工使用genAI更成熟，表明领域专业知识与genAI能力形成互补；(2)使用成熟度在不同职能间差异显著，战略、数字创新和项目管理三类职能最高，它们共同聚焦于公司级战略举措与组织变革；(3)成熟度随时间无改善，正式AI培训后也无持久提升，说明成熟使用模式难以改变。

Conclusion: 研究为管理者提供了度量与洞察员工生成式AI使用成熟度的工具与依据，以优化组织AI应用成效；同时也为后续研究者提供了可借鉴的度量方法和大规模实证基础。

Abstract: We study how sophistication in generative AI (genAI) use varies among the back-office workforce of a large firm. Using proprietary data, we observe 713,564 employee prompts and their corresponding large language model responses from nearly 4,000 back-office employees across 15 functional areas over eight months in 2025. We document three main findings. First, senior employees exhibit more sophisticated genAI use, consistent with domain expertise complementing genAI capabilities. Second, sophistication varies considerably across functions and is highest in Strategy, Digital Innovation, and Project Management, three groups that share a focus on firmwide strategic initiatives and organizational change. Third, we observe neither improvements in sophistication over time nor lasting improvements following formal AI training, suggesting that sophisticated use can be difficult to change. Together, our study provides measures of and insights into sophisticated genAI use that managers can use to improve outcomes and that researchers can use in future research.

</details>


### [406] [Learning a Continuous Sepsis Severity Score Without Hour-by-Hour Supervision: A Two-Site Retrospective Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27421)
*Kevin Zhu,Ryan Zhang,Baraa Abed,Tilendra Choudhary,Malvern Madondo,Mehak Arora,Yixuan Yang,Alasdair Gent,Aditya Nagori,Omer T. Inan,Krista L. Haines,Patrick Georgoff,Suresh M. Agarwal,Vijay Krishnamoorthy,Tetsu Ohnuma,Mihai V. Podgoreanu,Michael R. Pinsky,Gilles Clermont,Craig M. Coopersmith,Craig S. Jabaley,Rishikesan Kamaleswaran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究开发了一种基于患者轨迹的脓毒症严重程度指数，使用43个常规记录的变量和72小时治疗窗口，采用死亡率作为治疗级排序信号而非每状态目标，在两个医院系统共36,807名Sepsis-3患者中验证，显示出良好的预后区分能力和跨机构一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有脓毒症严重程度指数（如SOFA）依赖数十年前固定的变量和权重，粗粒度离散化且校准于过时队列，无法反映当代重症监护实践。目前没有直接从患者轨迹学习的替代方法在临床常规使用。

Method: 使用43个常规记录的变量，在72小时治疗窗口内开发脓毒症指数。创新之处在于将死亡率作为治疗级别的排序信号（而非每状态目标），允许积分在时间步上非均匀分布。采用两个医院系统的回顾性双队列研究（29,116和7,691名患者），用20%永久测试集评估，通过自助重采样获取不确定性区间。

Result: 非幸存者得分比幸存者高1.19-1.64分（0-10分制），在SOFA-2基线各分层中一致。指数变化与乳酸变化相关（Spearman rho=0.39）。跨机构模型一致性为同站点相关性的70-77%，外部患者内相关性为0.54和0.59（上限0.92和0.90）。与既有指数相关，而无效对照接近零。

Conclusion: 该指数提供逐小时预后信息，能有效区分患者结局且符合临床预期，有潜力作为辅助临床判断的决策支持工具。

Abstract: Currently used sepsis severity indices rely on fixed variables and weights established decades ago, which are coarsely discretized and calibrated to a cohort that no longer reflects contemporary critical care. No alternative learned directly from patient trajectories is in routine use. We conducted a retrospective two-cohort study on a total of 29,116 and 7,691 adult patients meeting Sepsis-3 criteria from two hospital systems in Massachusetts and Georgie, respectively.
  We developed a sepsis index using 43 routinely charted variables over a 72-hour treatment window. Unlike previous studies, we use mortality as a treatment-level ranking signal rather than a per-state target, allowing credit to be redistributed non-uniformly across timesteps. Evaluation was done on a permanent 20% test holdout, using clinical vignettes and Spearman correlation. Uncertainty intervals were obtained by bootstrap resampling of whole patients. Under this ranking scheme, non-survivors scored 1.19-1.64 points higher than survivors on a 0-10 scale within all strata of baseline SOFA-2, with similar results stratifying within lactate, mean arterial pressure (MAP), and creatinine. Within-patient change in the index correlated with change in lactate (Spearman rho = 0.39; n = 1,854). Similar, weaker correlations were found for MAP and creatinine. On a cohort level, cross-institutional agreement measured by Spearman correlation between models trained on different sites, were 70-77% of same-site correlation. External within-patient correlations were 0.54 and 0.59 against ceilings of 0.92 and 0.90. Our index also correlated with established indices, while null controls stayed near zero.
  Our index demonstrated hourly prognostic information that meaningfully separates patient outcomes and is consistent with clinical expectation, indicating potential as a decision support tool complementing clinical judgement.

</details>


### [407] [Mechanistic Reaction Prediction via Discrete Flow Matching on Graph-Structured Electron Occupation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27429)
*Nguyen Xuan-Vu,Octavian Susanu,Daniel Armstrong,Philippe Schwaller*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MAELLE是一种基于电子占据向量上的离散流匹配（flow matching）建模化学反应的方法。它将反应物到产物的映射形式化为连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC），在键合、非键合和氢位点上的图结构整数电子占据空间中操作，通过最优传输构建中间编辑轨迹，无需基元步骤标注。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大多数机器学习方法建模化学反应时，要么通过从头生成产物分子，要么通过启发式图编辑直接操作分子拓扑，而没有直接对化学反应的本质——电子空间的变换进行建模。

Method: 将反应物到产物的映射形式化为电子占据向量空间上的离散流匹配，具体为连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC）；使用最优传输推广离散流匹配混合路径，构建机制上可解释的中间编辑轨迹序列，无需基元步骤注释。

Result: 在USPTO-480K基准上取得与领先反应预测模型相当的竞争力；在两类分布外设置（结构复杂度和反应类型）中，现有方法性能下降时MAELLE仍保持稳健表现；能恢复与已知化学一致的机制轨迹并可预测副产物。

Conclusion: MAELLE通过直接在电子占据空间上建模化学反应，不仅获得了具有竞争力的反应预测性能，还天然具备机制的透明性，能够揭示反应机理并预测副产物，为化学反应建模提供了更本质的视角。

Abstract: Chemical reactions are fundamentally transformations in electron space, yet most machine learning approaches model them either through \textit{de novo} generation of product molecules or through heuristic graph edits that operate directly on molecular topology.
  We introduce MAELLE (\textbf{M}ech\textbf{A}nistic \textbf{E}dit f\textbf{L}ow-matching on e\textbf{L}ectron r\textbf{E}arrangements), which instead models reactions as discrete flow matching over electron occupation vectors.
  Concretely, we formulate the reactant-to-product mapping as a Continuous-time Markov Chain (CTMC) over the graph-structured integer-valued electron occupation space defined on all bonding, non-bonding, and hydrogen sites.
  To construct the intermediate edit trajectories, we generalize the discrete flow matching mixture path to discrete electron rearrangements using Optimal Transport, yielding a sequence of mechanistically interpretable edit moves without requiring elementary step annotations.
  MAELLE achieves competitive performance on the USPTO-480K benchmark compared with leading reaction prediction models.
  Beyond in-distribution accuracy, we evaluate robustness across two out-of-distribution settings - structural complexity and reaction type - and find that MAELLE maintains strong performance where existing methods degrade.
  Finally, because the learned flow operates over the full electron redistribution, MAELLE naturally recovers mechanistic trajectories that align with known chemistry and can predict side products of a reaction.

</details>


### [408] [WikiSkill: Compiling Agent Experience into Persistent Knowledge for Skill Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27454)
*Liyan Tang,Cyrus Rashtchian,Chun-Sung Ferng,Andrew Tomkins,Da-Cheng Juan,Tu Vu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出WikiSkill框架，通过将原始执行经验、累积知识与可执行技能分离，并持续将经验固化为持久知识库（wiki），使智能体技能与知识库协同进化。实验表明该方法在多个基准和模型上优于最先进的技能进化方法，且技能进化与模型规模互补，技能可跨模型迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有技能自动发现方法虽然能让智能体通过交互逐步适应，但指导技能开发的洞察通常分散在优化历史中，限制了跨迭代的系统性复用。

Method: WikiSkill将原始执行经验、累积知识和可执行技能三者分离，持续将经验整合进wiki知识库，后续技能更新可基于该知识库进行，实现技能与知识的协同进化。

Result: 在多个基准和模型上，WikiSkill一致优于最先进的技能进化方法；技能进化与模型规模互补，大模型从进化技能中获益更多，小模型加技能可超越无技能的大模型；进化技能可跨模型和模型家族迁移；消融实验确认wiki中的持久知识积累对技能进化至关重要。

Conclusion: 系统性地积累和精炼智能体经验，对于开发可复用和可迁移的技能具有显著益处，持久的知识库是有效技能进化的关键。

Abstract: Agent skills package specialized knowledge and workflows into reusable resources that extend AI agent capabilities. Recent work automatically discovers such skills from agent experience, which enables agents to progressively adapt through interaction. However, the insights that guide skill development typically remain scattered across optimization histories, limiting their systematic reuse across iterations. We introduce WikiSkill, a framework that co-evolves agent skills with a persistent knowledge base (wiki). At a high level, WikiSkill separates raw execution experience, accumulated knowledge, and executable skills, while continuously consolidating experience into the wiki, which subsequent skill updates can build on. Across diverse benchmarks and models, WikiSkill consistently outperforms state-of-the-art skill-evolution methods and improves over no-skill baselines in most model-benchmark settings. We find that skill evolution complements model scaling: larger models generally benefit more from evolved skills, while smaller models with skills can outperform substantially larger models without them. We also find that evolved skills transfer effectively across models and model families, and skills evolved by other models can outperform self-evolved skills. Finally, our ablation studies confirm that persistent knowledge accumulation in the wiki is critical for effective skill evolution. These results demonstrate the benefits of systematically accumulating and refining agent experience for developing reusable and transferable skills.

</details>


<div id='cs.MM'></div>

# cs.MM [[Back]](#toc)

### [409] [Emotion Understanding in Streaming Video with Trajectory-Aware Reliability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26786)
*Qingsong Wang,Qigong Lei,Zitong Wang,Bohan Yu,Zhiang Dong,Jian liu,Weiqiang Wang,Chang Yao,Jingyuan Chen*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 本文提出TRACE框架，将流式视频情感理解建模为可靠性感知的决策过程，通过轨迹稳定性估计来自适应分配多模态上下文推理，在保持精度的同时降低计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统视频情感理解被当作离线分类问题，需要完整视频段。但实时交互需要从不完整且不断变化的证据中做出情感决策。仅靠高置信度的前缀预测可能因底层信念轨迹不稳定或情感类别反复切换而不可靠，因此需要可靠性感知的决策机制。

Method: 提出TRACE轨迹感知可靠性框架：(1) 从流式音频前缀形成低延迟情感信念；(2) 从置信度、熵、稳定性和类别切换模式估计可靠性；(3) 利用视觉、文本和相邻话语证据选择性触发上下文信念重解释。稳定情况保持在低延迟在线路径，不确定情况则分配更强的多模态推理。

Result: 在StreamMER、MELD和MER2024数据集上的实验表明，TRACE改善了准确率-成本权衡，在减少不必要上下文推理的同时保留了大部分全上下文增益。

Conclusion: TRACE验证了轨迹感知可靠性估计能有效区分稳定与不确定的流式情感预测，为实时情感理解的效率与准确性平衡提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Video emotion understanding is commonly studied as an offline classification problem, where the complete video segment is available before prediction. Real-time interaction, however, requires emotion decisions from incomplete and evolving evidence. This paper studies streaming video emotion understanding as a reliability-aware decision process over evolving emotion beliefs. In this setting, a single confident prefix prediction can still be unreliable when the underlying belief trajectory is unstable or repeatedly switches across emotion classes. We propose TRACE, a trajectory-aware reliability framework that forms low-latency emotion beliefs from streaming audio prefixes, estimates reliability from confidence, entropy, stability, and class-switching patterns, and selectively invokes contextual belief reinterpretation with visual, textual, and neighboring-utterance evidence. TRACE keeps stable cases in the low-latency online pathway while allocating stronger multimodal reasoning to uncertain cases that remain ambiguous. Experiments on StreamMER, MELD, and MER2024 show that TRACE improves the accuracy-cost trade-off, retaining most full-context gains while reducing unnecessary contextual reasoning.

</details>


### [410] [Self-Reflective Multi-modal Reasoning for Short-Video Fake News Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26787)
*Pinjie Xu,Yuzhou Yang,Zhikai Tan,Qichao Ying,Zaiyang Yu,Ce Li,Zhenxing Qian*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 本文提出SRM-FND，一个自反思多模态推理框架，用于短视频假新闻检测。它通过对比性审议、迭代根因诊断和矫正提示精化生成高质量推理，结合双阶段主题自适应视觉语言模型微调，并对不确定案例进行置信度驱动的跨样本复核，在FakeSV和FakeTT数据集上优于强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有假新闻检测依赖大语言模型和视觉语言模型进行推理分析，但仍面临三大挑战：在缺乏ground-truth思维链监督下提升推理质量、利用改进的推理促进下游模型微调、以及将单样本欺诈模式发现与跨样本验证相结合。

Method: SRM-FND框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 自反思推理机制——通过对比性审议、迭代根因诊断和矫正提示精化提升推理质量，由Blind Analyst、Counter-Conclusion Reasoner和Self-Consistency Arbiter协作识别和保留判别性推理；(2) 双阶段主题自适应视觉语言模型微调——改善多模态grounding并实现轻量级主题专化；(3) 置信度驱动的跨样本复核——对不确定案例检索可信和可疑的同事件示例进行验证。

Result: 在FakeSV和FakeTT数据集上的实验表明，SRM-FND优于强基线方法，产生更可靠和可解释的预测，并在跨数据集性能上取得显著改进。

Conclusion: SRM-FND通过自反思多模态推理有效解决了短视频假新闻检测中的推理质量、下游微调和跨样本验证问题，验证了该框架的有效性和泛化能力。

Abstract: Recent fake news detection pipelines increasingly leverage large language models and vision-language models for reasoning-based analysis. However, several challenges remain open: improving reasoning quality through self-reflection without ground-truth chain-of-thought supervision, using improved reasoning to benefit downstream model fine-tuning, and connecting single-sample fraudulent-pattern discovery with cross-sample verification. We propose SRM-FND, a self-reflective multimodal reasoning framework for short-video fake news detection. SRM-FND develops higher-quality reasoning through contrastive deliberation, iterative root-cause diagnosis, and corrective prompt refinement. A Blind Analyst, Counter-Conclusion Reasoner, and Self-Consistency Arbiter collaboratively identify and retain discriminative rationales. The framework also incorporates dual-phase, topic-adaptive vision-language model fine-tuning to improve multimodal grounding and enable lightweight topic specialization. For uncertain cases, it performs confidence-driven cross-sample review by retrieving credible and suspicious co-event examples. Experiments on FakeSV and FakeTT show that SRM-FND outperforms strong baselines, produces more reliable and interpretable predictions, and delivers noticeable improvements in cross-dataset performance.

</details>


### [411] [How AI Experiences Art: Emergent Aesthetic Structure in a Self-Supervised Multimodal Embedding Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27121)
*Corey D. C. Heath*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个自监督框架，将四种模态（文本、音频、图像和视频）投影到共享的256维嵌入空间，并通过迭代聚类来发现美学结构，探讨了AI模型对人类媒体美学分类与人类情感标注之间的差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 美学是艺术作品象征意义的重要组成部分，尽管具有主观性，人类会基于情感对艺术进行分类。但目前尚未充分探索AI模型如何在没有显式标签或跨模态监督的情况下，形成对人类生成媒体的美学分类。

Method: 构建一个自监督框架，将四种模态（文本、音频、图像和视频）投影到共享的256维嵌入空间，并应用迭代聚类来发现美学结构。

Result: 讨论了在弱监督多模态数据集上，AI生成的聚类分配与人类情感注册标签之间的差异。

Conclusion: 该工作有助于理解AI如何构建跨模态相似性、组织异构媒体集合以用于检索增强生成（RAG），以及实现自动化数据标注。

Abstract: Aesthetics are an important part of the symbolism of artistic works. Although subjective, humans categorize art based on the emotion evoked regardless of modality. What remains under-explored is how AI models form their own aesthetic categorization of human-produced media without explicit labels or cross-modal supervision. We present a self-supervised framework that projects four modalities (text, audio, image and video) into a shared 256-dimensional embedding space and applies iterative clustering to discover aesthetic structure. We discuss the divergence between AI-generated cluster assignments and human affective register labels on a weakly supervised multimodal dataset. This work has applications in understanding how AI structures cross-modal similarity, organizing heterogeneous media collections for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and automated data labeling.

</details>
